entries.description: The whole cockpit bring-up, in order: (1) loads vue\\<herc> -- int32 viewCount then viewCount x 32-byte records {int x0,y0,x1,y1, cx, cy, canvasOriginX, canvasOriginY}, all coordinates shifted by VideoMode_X/YCoordShift; every retail .VUE has viewCount=4; (2) allocates 4 slots for canopy bitmaps, 4 x 0x204 clip-region blocks and 4 span tables; (3) per view i, calls CockpitClipRegions_Load on ed<i>/hd<i> and ClipRegions_BuildScanlineSpans on the result, and (unless CockpitArt_LoadOnDemand) CockpitCanopy_LoadViewBitmap for db<i>/hb<i>; (4) builds the CockpitView widget object (CockpitView_Ctor -> ColorSchemePanels_LoadAll, which sets CockpitViewInstance) and Gau_BuildCockpitWidgets; (5) THE PER-HERC COCKPIT COLOUR SCHEME: Palette_InstallRange(0x2a, 0x18, COCKPIT.DPL.entries + (schemeIdx*0x18 + 0x20)*4), i.e. live palette slots 42..65 are overwritten with COCKPIT.DPL entries [32 + 24*schemeIdx .. +24), where schemeIdx = mechTypeRecord+0x52 = offset 80 of simvol0/dat/<MECH>.DAT. Retail values are a 0-8 permutation: APOCA 0, COLOSSUS 1, SAMSON 2, MAVERICK 3, OGRE 4, OUTLAW 5, RAPTOR2 6, RAZOR 7, TOMAHAWK 8, so the nine 24-entry schemes fill COCKPIT.DPL entries 32..247. This matches the independently measured retail screenshots exactly (APOCA renders canopy index i as COCKPIT.DPL[i-10] => base 32; COLOSSUS as COCKPIT.DPL[i+14] => base 56) and explains why every WORLD<n>.DPL parks exactly slots 42-65 at filler green. (6) Repeats the same install with IMPACTCP.DPL into the secondary palette object ImpactPaletteObject for the damage flash.

entries.name: CockpitCanopy_LoadViewBitmap
entries.description: (manager, view), MECHVIEW.CPP: the .DB0-.DB2 / .HB0-.HB2 load. For a view other than 4 whose slot of +8 is empty it copies the folder literal PTR_DAT_004a0a28 (dba), or PTR_DAT_004a0a40 (hba) when VideoMode_PanelMode is 3, into a stack buffer, writes the file number (the view, less 1 above 2) over its third character with _itoa, giving db0-db2 or hb0-hb2, and loads <folder>\<name +0x2d> with VolRStream_CtorFromPath and ClassItem_LoadResource into slot view, asserting at severity 5 (line 0x12e) when the stream does not open. With maybe_CockpitLayoutMode 1 and view 0 it adds 1 to the third character of the shared literal, not the stack buffer, opens the stack buffer's path again (assert line 0x135) and loads it into slot 1, so that branch loads file 0 twice and changes the global folder name. After file 2 it copies the slot into slot 3: views 2 and 3 share one bitmap, view 3 drawn mirrored by CockpitView_SetView.

entries.name: CockpitCanopy_FreeViewBitmap
entries.description: (manager, view): for views 1 and 2, and for view 0 (first freeing slot 1 when maybe_CockpitLayoutMode is 1), destroys slot view of +8 with GLBitmapArray_Dtor(array, 3), counting the destructor, and clears the slot, and slot 3 as well for view 2, which shares its handle; returns for other views. es2_xref finds one call, from CockpitView_SetView, which makes it under CockpitArt_LoadOnDemand.

entries.name: CockpitView_ApplyViewState
entries.description: (manager, view): installs one view's state into the render context DAT_006c5ff4. Returns at once when view is the current view +0x14 or above 4. With CockpitViewShakeArmed set it calls CockpitView_ClearShake and sets CockpitShakeReseedAfterSlide. View 4: clears CockpitShakeReseedAfterSlide and, unless in view 4, saves the current view at +0x23, copies the block DAT_004cfb1c into the context's clip block, sets clip mode +0x208 to 2 and ActiveScanlineClipSpans to 0, copies ExternalView_Rect's six ints to ctx[0x84..0x89], sets the current view to 4, CockpitView_DisableWidgets(+0x1f), zeroes the canvas origin DAT_004cfa24/28 and calls View_FillOutside3dRect. Other views: from view 4 CockpitView_EnableWidgets; from view 2 or 3, outside maybe_CockpitLayoutMode 2, CockpitWidgets_TranslateForView and MessagePort_ShiftRect by that view's canvas origin; on the scroll-window path moves the window through g_RasterRoutines_SetOrigin; from any other view, outside layout mode 2, sets the draw page's origin (paged path, new views other than 2 and 3) or the window's (scroll-window path) by the new .VUE record's canvas origin and moves the widgets and the message port's box by the old origin ((0, 0) for -1) less the new. Then copies the view's 0x204-byte clip block (+0xc) into the context, points ActiveScanlineClipSpans at +0x10[view], sets clip mode 2, copies the record's six ints to ctx[0x84..0x89], and stores the canvas origin in DAT_004d25da/de in layout mode 2, otherwise in DAT_004cfa24/28, added to ctx[0x88]/[0x89].

entries.name: CockpitView_SetView
entries.description: (manager, view): for a view below 5, and not view 1 when maybe_CockpitLayoutMode is 1, CockpitView_ApplyViewState; then for any view but 4, with CockpitArt_LoadOnDemand set CockpitCanopy_LoadViewBitmap first and CockpitCanopy_FreeViewBitmap last, it blits frame 0 of slot view's bitmap array at (0, 0) with flags 2 (mirrored) for view 3 and 0 otherwise, the render context's +0x208 at 0 for the blit: through Bitmap_BlitScaled to 0x140 x 0x1e0 in layout mode 2 (view 3 with +0x208 1, +0x21c 0x1df and x -1), otherwise Bitmap_Blit. In layout mode 1 it also blits slot 1 at y + 0xc5 for view 0 and, for views 2 and 3, fills {0, 0xc5, 0x140, 0x1e0} on the page +0x8c in COLORS.DAT id 19 (DAT_004d3c26). For views below 4 CockpitView_InvalidateWidgets(+0x1f). Stores the view at +0x14.

entries.name: CockpitView_QueueViewCommand
entries.description: Latches a pending view-change command (field +0x18) from an input action, guarded by the current view (field +0x14). Consumed by CockpitView_ProcessViewCommand.

entries.name: CockpitView_ProcessViewCommand
entries.description: Stages the pending view command (+0x18) for CockpitView_StepViewTransition, which runs it at the end of the next frame. While the cooldown +0x1d is nonzero it only decrements it and returns. Otherwise, when the view-change flag +0x1c is clear, it installs the destination view's state -- CockpitView_ApplyViewState for commands 0, 1 and 2 (view 4, external), CockpitView_SetView for 3 (the view saved at +0x23), 4 (view 2), 5 (view 3) and 6 (view 0, which also re-enables the widgets), each SetView putting +0x14 back so the current view index is unchanged until the slide -- and sets +0x1c; a set flag hides the system buttons (SystemButtons_HideAll). The -/+0x3600 yaw adds on 4/5/6 are gated on VideoMode_PanelMode == 1, which no retail mode stores, so a glance never turns the camera: it is the forward view's image plane continued sideways (docs/retail/simulation/cockpit-views.md). On the scroll-window path it first moves the image into the other half of the back buffer when a glance target would fall outside it (tests on Display_OriginX); on the -b paged path it instead holds glance commands until the draw page (+0x88) is 0 or 2 (1 under panel mode 1), and every pass past that gate and the cooldown calls Vga_WaitVerticalRetrace.

entries.name: CockpitView_StepViewTransition
entries.description: (manager): runs the view command +0x18 that CockpitView_ProcessViewCommand staged with +0x1c set, and returns the current view +0x14; does nothing else while the command is -1 or +0x1c is clear. It sets _DAT_004d2702 to 0, zeroes the display clip block's +0x208/+0x20c for the first half, and calls slot +0x18 of CockpitViewInstance's +0x20b object for every command but 2. On the -b paged path (Display_UseScrollWindow 0), commands 0 and 1 outside maybe_CockpitLayoutMode 2, and 3, copy the outgoing image from +0x8c to +0x88 with Region_CopyBetweenPages. It clears +0x1c, then: 0 and 1 move the window or the page origin down or up by the two .VUE records' canvas origin y difference (travel 0x1e0 and a doubled step in layout mode 2), 10 rows a step, with Display_Present after each step on the scroll-window path and the squad message port's slots +0x14/+0x18 around each step and MessagePort_CopyBoxBetweenPages after while its +0x49e is set; then Cockpit_UseOffForwardCursor or Cockpit_UseForwardCursor, the current view + 1 or - 1 and SimInput_SetEnabled(0) or (1), layout mode 2 also flipping the pages. 2 hides the cursor, DAT_0049dbdf = 0, current view 4, +0x36 = 1, and saves sound 0x2d's volume and sets it to 100 when effects are on. 3 presents on the scroll-window path, shows the cursor, calls the port's slot +0x18, sets the current view from +0x23 and puts the volume back. 4, 5 and 6 slide x by 0x14 columns a step the same way, then Cockpit_UseOffForwardCursor, and on the paged path show +0x8c, draw on +0x88, swap the two and copy the screen across; they set the current view to 2, 3 or 0 (layout mode 2 flips the pages and copies without sliding). DAT_004a365e is 0 during a slide and 1 after. It ends with +0x18 = -1, the word +0x1d = 2 (a two-frame cooldown), CockpitView_SetShakeBand(10) when CockpitShakeReseedAfterSlide is set, and SystemButtons_RestoreAll. The slide loop has no timer, retrace wait or frame boundary of its own, so its speed is the CPU's. es2_xref finds two calls, from Sim_EndFrame. See docs/retail/simulation/cockpit-views.md.

entries.name: CmdLine_SetCockpitOverride
entries.description: (name): the -C switch. _stricmp against the 13 names at 0049ac64 (ROADRUNNER ... TEST3); on a match stores the index in CockpitOverride_Index and the name pointer in CockpitOverride_Name. Sim_ParseCommandLine calls it with the text after -C.

entries.name: CockpitView_SetShakeBand
entries.description: (amplitude): seeds the shake's band. Returns at once when CockpitViewManager_Published's manager is in view 4 (+0x14) or has +0x1c set. Takes the offset 004cfae4/004cfae8 from Display_OriginX/Y on the scroll-window path and from the canvas origin 004cfa24/004cfa28 otherwise, and copies it to the resting copy 004cfadc/004cfae0. View 1: limits 004cfaec/004cfaf0 = {y - amplitude, y}. Views 2 and 3: on the paged path zeroes 004cfae0 and 004cfae4; with the render context's +0x208/+0x20c at 0 saves the region 004cfb02 into 004cfb18 with Region_Save, fills its rect 004cfb06 with COLORS.DAT id 19 (DAT_004d3c26) and makes +0x88 the draw page. Views 0, 2 and 3 then take {y, y + amplitude}, y the canvas origin plus Display_OriginY on the scroll-window path; any other view takes no limits. Zeroes 004cfaf4 and sets CockpitViewShakeArmed. CockpitView_StepViewTransition calls it with 10.

entries.name: CockpitView_StepShake
entries.description: (step): one frame of the shake. While CockpitViewShakeArmed is set and the manager is not in view 4, moves 004cfae8 by up to step toward whichever of the limits 004cfaec/004cfaf0 is farther, toward 004cfaec when the two are equally far, so the view ping-pongs across the band; moves the window to the page +0x8c's origin plus 004cfae4/004cfae8 through g_RasterRoutines_SetOrigin, Display_SetOrigin on driver 3, which ignores the page, so the canopy in the back buffer moves on screen; subtracts the step from the current view's clip regions (a rect region's last row +0x14, a span region's first row); adds the step to 004cfaf4; moves ActiveScanlineClipSpans' first dword by step x 8 and its second by -step, and the render context's +0x218/+0x21c by -step; and moves the cockpit's widgets by (0, -step) with CockpitWidgets_TranslateForView.

entries.name: CockpitView_ClearShake
entries.description: Undoes CockpitView_SetShakeBand. While CockpitViewShakeArmed is set and the manager is not in view 4, moves the window back to the page +0x8c's origin plus the resting copy 004cfadc/004cfae0 through g_RasterRoutines_SetOrigin, moves the current view's clip regions, ActiveScanlineClipSpans and the render context's +0x218/+0x21c back by 004cfaf4, in views 2 and 3 puts the region 004cfb02 back from 004cfb18 with Region_Restore on the draw page and on +0x88 (leaving +0x8c the draw page), moves the widgets by (0, 004cfaf4) with CockpitWidgets_TranslateForView, and clears 004cfaf4 and the armed byte. es2_xref finds calls from CockpitView_ApplyViewState, Cockpit_StartHitShake, Cockpit_HitShakeTick, LiftStart_Rise and Sim_DeathFlash.

entries.name: CockpitView_ForgetKickOffset
entries.description: Zeroes CockpitView_KickOffset without touching the render context.

entries.name: CockpitView_SetKickOffset
entries.description: (value): on the current render context (006c5ff4), +0x224 -= CockpitView_KickOffset, then += value & 0xffff, which it stores in CockpitView_KickOffset.

entries.name: CockpitView_ClearKickOffset
entries.description: Takes CockpitView_KickOffset back out of the current render context's +0x224 and zeroes it.

entries.name: CockpitView_GetShakeOffset
entries.description: No arguments: sets the byte 0049add5 to 1 when it is 0 and returns a pointer to the static pair 004cfd40, written as {0, (int)(short)004cfaf4}, the sum of CockpitView_StepShake's steps. Sim_RenderFrame adds the pair to Sim_RenderContext's +0x220/+0x224, the projection pair, for the frame's draw and takes it out after.

entries.name: ExternalView_SetRect
entries.description: (rect, offset): stores the four-int rect (left, top, right, bottom) in ExternalView_Rect and at 004cfd28, and the two-int offset -- the projection centre negated, as ExternalView_DefaultRect's (-0xa0, -0x5a) shifted is -- at 004cfad4/004cfad8; when CockpitViewManager_Published is in view 4, also writes them into the render context's (006c5ff4) +0x210..+0x224. PreferencesPanel_Raise calls it (read).

entries.name: ExternalView_ResetRect
entries.description: No arguments: copies ExternalView_DefaultRect's six ints to ExternalView_Rect and its first four to 004cfd28; when CockpitViewManager_Published answers a manager in view 4 (+0x14), also writes the six to the render context's (006c5ff4) +0x210..+0x224. ExternalView_SetRect with the default as its source. es2_xref finds one call, from PreferencesPanel_Raise.

entries.name: CockpitViewManager_FlushBorderFill
entries.description: (manager): View_FillOutside3dRect when the current view +0x14 is 4, the external view; then clears +0x36. CockpitView_ProcessViewCommand calls it first when +0x36 is set.

entries.name: View_FillOutside3dRect
entries.description: No arguments: floods the four bands around the 3D rect ExternalView_Rect (left, top, right, bottom) within the viewport DAT_004d25c2 x DAT_004d25c6 with COLORS.DAT id 19 (DAT_004d3c26). It installs the fill brush {0, colour} at the render context's (006c5ff4) +0x22c, zeroes the context's +0x208/+0x20c for the fills and puts them back, and issues one Raster_FillRect per non-empty band: {0, 0, w - 1, top - 1}, {0, bottom + 1, w - 1, h - 1}, {0, top, left - 1, bottom} and {right + 1, top, w - 1, bottom}. es2_xref finds calls from CockpitView_ApplyViewState, CockpitViewManager_FlushBorderFill and PreferencesPanel_Raise, two. See docs/retail/simulation/external-views.md.

entries.name: ExternalView_GetRect
entries.description: No arguments: returns &ExternalView_Rect. es2_xref finds one call, from ViewChain_DrawCaption.

entries.name: CockpitView_ShowsWorld
entries.description: Returns 1 when the current view's .VUE rect bottom (record +0xc of the 0x20-byte record CockpitViewManagerPublished+0x14 indexes under +4) is at least 1, or a view transition (+0x1c) is running; 0 otherwise -- so 0 in the heads-down view, whose rect is empty on every HERC but RAZOR. Sim_RenderFrame draws the terrain only when it returns 1.

entries.name: CockpitViewManager_StaticInit
entries.description: Static initialiser of the cockpit view-manager module (Borland _INIT_ entry 004a7b04, priority 0x20): Rtl_VectorNew(CockpitVueRecords (004cfa2c), 0x20, 4, 1, CockpitVueRecord_ElementCtor) for the four .VUE view records; constructs two global GLRectangleRegions at 004cfafe and 004cfd20 (ClassItem, GLBase, GLRegion, GLRectangleRegion vtables in turn, +4 zeroed), counting six live destructors; then stores the rect {0, 0xd2, 0x140, 0xf0} at 0049ac54/58/5c/60, ordered min/max per axis.

entries.name: CockpitViewManager_StaticDtor
entries.description: CockpitViewManager_StaticInit's _EXIT_ routine (Borland _EXIT_ entry 004a7c24): six decrements of *Rtl_DtorCountPtr, matching the init's six increments; those decrements are its whole body.

entries.name: CockpitVueRecord_ElementCtor
entries.description: (record): returns its argument -- the per-element constructor CockpitViewManager_StaticInit hands Rtl_VectorNew for the four 32-byte view records at CockpitVueRecords (004cfa2c), which CockpitViewManager_LoadViews points the manager's +4 at and reads vue\<herc> into.

entries.name: CockpitClipRegions_Load
entries.description: CockpitClipRegions_Load(path, out, shift): reads a clip-region file through a VolRStream into the 0x204-byte block at out (int count, then up to 128 region pointers; no bound check against 128). shift is int[2] {xShift, yShift}. Callers found by es2_xref: CockpitViewManager_LoadViews (per-view .HD0-.HD3 / .ED0-.ED3) and HddDisplay_Ctor (edg\hddclip). Layout after the 9-byte VOL prefix: int16 rectCount, rectCount x {int16 y0, y1, x0, x1}; int16 blockCount, blockCount x {int16 firstRow, int16 rowCount, rowCount x {int16 xStart, int16 xEnd}}; reading stops after the last block. Each rect becomes a 0x18-byte GLRectangleRegion (out stores obj+4: type 0 at +4, x0 +8, y0 +0xc, x1 +0x10, y1 +0x14), each coordinate shifted left by its axis's shift and, when that shift is nonzero, the inclusive ends y1/x1 get (1 << shift) - 1 added. Each span block becomes an 8-byte {int type 2, ptr data}, data a Mem_NewArray holding {int16 firstRow << yShift, int16 rowCount << yShift, then the pairs}; with yShift nonzero each file pair is written to its row and copied into the next one, and with xShift nonzero every pair becomes {xStart << xShift, (xEnd << xShift) + 1}. count = rects + blocks.

entries.name: World_LoadTheater
entries.description: (header): DBSim_LoadScriptDat passes script.dat's 20-byte header; it copies it to 004cfd48 and names the theater's files world<N>, N = 2 x header word 0 + header word 9 (004cfd5a). Palette_LoadAndActivate(dpl\world<N>); opens wld\world<N> with VolRStream_CtorFromPath, builds g_TheaterHzline (0049aee0) with Mem_New(0x7a) and Hzline_Ctor, then reads eight int16 into the hzline (shorts 0, 2, 3, 5 and 6 to +0x6c, +0x54, +0x58, +0x5c and +0x60; Hzline_SetColors with 1, 4 and 7) and stores short4 + short6 - 1 at 0049aee8; six more int16, the second to World_FlatSetSelector (0049aeea), the third and fourth to 004cfd76 and 004cfd78, the others unused; 004cfd74 = 0x40, 004cfd7a = 0x62. Two int32-counted int32 tables to WorldShades_BandsTagged and WorldShades_BandsTag0, the counts' low halves at 004cfd5c and 004cfd5e; int16 rows (004cfd62) and cols (004cfd60); two cols x 4-byte range tables around an unused int16, expanded by Palette_InterpolateIndexRanges into WorldShades_LevelRanges, then two 4-byte ranges into WorldShades_BlendRanges; two unused int16; two int32 to WorldShades_DistanceOffsets (004cfd6c, 004cfd70); five NUL-terminated strings, the third, when not empty, loaded with Palette_LoadDpl(dpl\<name>) into ImpactPaletteObject, the fourth kept, the first, second and fifth unused. Closes it; opens cyc\world<N> with VolRStream_Open and, when it opens with a non-zero int16 count (0049aef0), allocates count x 6 bytes (0049aeec) and reads count records of three int16 at a 12-byte stride, registering each with PaletteCycle_Register. World_LoadShades('shades'). Reads rmp\world<N>: an int32 width and height, ShadeRamp_Allocate(k, k, width x height) with k = ((004d25c2 + 004d25c6) x Math_CosBam(-0x2000) >> 14) + 5, and width x height x 256 bytes into ShadeRampTable. Terrain_BindTextureBank(fourth string), Raster_SetShadeRampDimensions(width, height), 004a5b18 = ShadeRampTable, 004a5b1c = 004a5b20 = width, and FlatObj_LoadResources(World_FlatSetSelector). Docs: docs/retail/formats/wld-world.md#the-load.

entries.name: Scene_DrawTerrainPass
entries.description: (view): sets +0x71 of the theater's horizon object g_TheaterHzline and has Terrain_ProjectFarEdgeAhead write into its +0x72; when that object exists, Hzline_Draw(it, view, &DAT_004cfa24, the view's canvas origin) paints the sky backdrop; then slot +0x34 of DAT_0049aee4 when that is non-null, Scene_DrawTerrain(view) and Palette_NoOp. Sim_RenderFrame's conditional arm.

entries.name: World_LoadShades
entries.description: (name): reads dat\<name> -- World_LoadTheater passes 'shades' -- as a count byte N, then N zeroed 5-byte records {byte count, pointer} at WorldShades_TypeTable (004cfd64) (N at 004cfd68), then a byte K and K entries {record index byte, count byte, count two-byte pairs}, each pair list going into a new array on that record. WorldShades_ApplyForObject (0042e8e8) indexes the table by an object's type tag (+4).

entries.name: WorldShades_DistanceBand
entries.description: (obj, distance): the distance band index for an object's type tag (obj+4). Tag 0 uses the .WLD's second distance table (WorldShades_BandsTag0 (004cfd88), count 004cfd5e); any other tag the first (WorldShades_BandsTagged (004cfd84), count 004cfd5c), and tag 5 first adds WorldShades_DistanceOffsets (004cfd6c)[obj vtable +0x10 (SimObject_GetShapeRadius) >= 5000] to distance, clamped at 0. Returns in AX how many leading thresholds are <= distance (unsigned), at most count - 1.

entries.name: WorldShades_ApplyForObject
entries.description: (obj, distance, blend): re-points shade ramps by distance before a draw. When 0049aef2 is set it runs WorldShades_ResetRamps instead. Otherwise it takes the SHADES.DAT record for the type tag obj+4 (5 bytes at WorldShades_TypeTable (004cfd64) + tag*5: count byte, pointer to {ramp, column} byte pairs) and, when the count is non-zero, the band b = WorldShades_DistanceBand(obj, max(distance, 0)); for each pair, the index range WorldShades_LevelRanges (004cfd7c)[(column * 004cfd62 + b)] ({int16 start, int16 count}) is installed into that shade ramp through Palette_SetRampsToRange (00430518). With blend set it calls Palette_SetRampsToRangeList (00430590) with a two-segment descriptor instead: the band range shortened by count/4 + 1, and WorldShades_BlendRanges (004cfd80)[b] ending count/4 entries early and lengthened to count/4 + 1; Palette_SetRampsToRangeList (00430590) reads ramp 0's segments contiguously from the first pointer, so its second segment is the four bytes of the pointer array at [EBP-0x10]. ObjList_DrawEntryRender passes the entry's object, distance (+0x12) and byte 004cfa08 (copied from 004d2549 by ObjList_DrawCellObjects); Terrain_FillCellUntextured passes a stack object with tag 7, distance 0, blend 0.

entries.name: WorldShades_ResetRamps
entries.description: Installs the index range {16, 16} into shade ramps 0, 2, 4, 6, 8, 10, 12 and 0x18, one Palette_SetRampsToRange (00430518) call each. WorldShades_ApplyForObject calls it when 0049aef2 is set; an absolute-address search of the disassembly finds one reference to 0049aef2, that read, and the byte is 0 in the image.

entries.name: Palette_ActivateImpact
entries.description: Swaps the active palette to ImpactPaletteObject through Palette_SetActive, saving the previous one at 004cfd8c/004cfd90 and latching 0049aef3. The flash half of the cockpit damage shake.

entries.name: Palette_ToggleImpact
entries.description: Swaps the saved and active palettes and flips 0049aef3, so repeated calls alternate between the theater palette and its impact palette -- unless Palette_RestoreFromImpact ran while the impact palette was active, which leaves the saved slot 004cfd8c on the theater palette, so later toggles swap it with itself. Called once per HitShakeNextToggleTick expiry while the shake runs.

entries.name: Palette_RestoreFromImpact
entries.description: Puts the palette Palette_ActivateImpact saved back. Called when the shake ends and when a new shake restarts over a running one.

entries.name: WorldShades_IsBeyondLastBand
entries.description: (obj, distance): WorldShades_DistanceBand's table choice -- tag 0 the second .WLD table, any other tag the first, tag 5 adding WorldShades_DistanceOffsets (004cfd6c)[shape radius >= 5000] and tag 8 adding WorldShades_DistanceOffsets (004cfd6c), clamped at 0 -- then returns whether the table's last threshold is below distance (unsigned). No caller found by es2_xref.

entries.name: Palette_NoOp
entries.description: Returns immediately. LiftStart_DarkenPalette and Sim_InitMissionSession call it.

entries.name: Hzline_Ctor
entries.description: hzline constructor (vtable 0049afb0, RTTI name 'hzline', 0x7a bytes over TSGroup): TSGroup_Ctor, then the defaults +0x6c = 1, +0x54 = 3, +0x58 = 16, +0x5c = 1, +0x60 = 8, +0x64 = +0x68 = 1, +0x50 = 0, +0x70 = 0, +0x71 = 1. World_LoadTheater overwrites +0x54..+0x60 and +0x6c from the .WLD.
entries.source: DBSIM decompile at 0042eb5c; RTTI via es2_classes.py; docs/retail/rendering/distance-fog-and-sky.md#the-sky--hzline

entries.name: Hzline_SetColors
entries.description: (self, zenithColor, groundColor, yOffset): +0x28 = (zenithColor + band count +0x58 - 1) & 0xffffff, the horizon colour; +0x2c = groundColor & 0xffffff; +0x30 = yOffset. World_LoadTheater passes .WLD shorts 1, 4 and 7.
entries.signature: void __cdecl Hzline_SetColors(hzline *self, int zenithColor, int groundColor, int yOffset)

entries.name: Hzline_Draw
entries.description: (self, view, canvasOrigin): Hzline_DrawWithOffset(self, view, self+0x30, canvasOrigin). Called only by Scene_DrawTerrainPass, with &DAT_004cfa24.

entries.name: Hzline_DrawWithOffset
entries.description: (self, view, yOffset, canvasOrigin): +0x34 = -view pitch (+0x10), +0x36 = view roll (+0x12); Hzline_BuildHorizon; adds yOffset >> 1 to both line ends' y; Hzline_FillSky; moves both ends down one row; Hzline_FillGround.
entries.signature: void __cdecl Hzline_DrawWithOffset(hzline *self, void *view, int yOffset, int *canvasOrigin)

entries.name: Hzline_BuildHorizon
entries.description: (self, canvasOrigin): writes the horizon line's screen ends to +0x38/+0x3c (first) and +0x40/+0x44 (second): -cos roll and +cos roll times (256 << coord shift) across either side of a midpoint f*tan(pitch) from the projection centre (006c60b8/bc) along the rolled screen vertical, f = 2^006c60ac, cos(pitch) floored at 1 in Q14, plus +0x30 in y. So the first end is the left one up to a quarter turn of roll and the right one past it. A non-zero canvas origin lengthens it by its own length: both ends for a non-zero y, else the end on the x's side. +0x48/+0x4c = (sin roll, -cos roll), Q14, the band step direction; the test that would negate it compares the unsigned negated pitch (+0x34) with -0x4000 and is never true.

entries.name: Hzline_FillSky
entries.description: Paints the sky above the horizon line with the solid brush {0, colour} at the render context's +0x22c: +0x58 - 1 bands of +0x54 rows, the first in the horizon colour +0x28 and each next one entry lower, then the zenith colour beyond the last. Raster_FillRect rects when roll (+0x36) is 0, Raster_DrawPolygonReversed quads otherwise; the rolled bands' y offset uses one band fewer than the level fill's.

entries.name: Hzline_FillGround
entries.description: Fills the horizon line's ground side in one colour, bounded by the view rect at render context +0x210/+0x214/+0x218/+0x21c (left, top, right, bottom). With +0x71 set, which Scene_DrawTerrainPass sets before its Hzline_Draw call, the colour is the horizon colour +0x28: Raster_FillRect from the line to the bottom (+0x21c) when roll (+0x36) is 0; otherwise a polygon through Raster_DrawPolygonDispatch of the line's two ends (+0x38/+0x3c, +0x40/+0x44) closed through view-rect corners. When the first end is higher on screen: bottom-right if the second end's x is past the right side, then bottom-left, then top-left if the first end's x is right of the left side. Otherwise: top-right if the second end's x is short of the right side, then bottom-right, then bottom-left if the first end's x is past the left side. Hzline_BuildHorizon's ends swap sides past a quarter turn of roll, so the polygon lies on the screen-upper side when inverted; at a roll of exactly 0x8000 the line is level, the corners are top-right and bottom-right, and the outline crosses itself. The rolled branch moves the line by its midpoint's offset from Terrain_ProjectFarEdgeAhead's point (+0x72/+0x76) into polygon slots 2-3, which every path overwrites or leaves past the vertex count. With +0x71 clear it would paint +0x60 bands of +0x5c rows down from colour +0x2c + +0x60 - 1.

entries.name: Hzline_BlitHorizonStrip
entries.description: (self, bitmapSet, view, yOffset, offset): blits the frames of a bitmap set (count +4, frame list +8) one after another along the hzline's horizon line, starting from a position scrolled by the view's heading (+0x14) and wrapping the frame index; VideoMode_BlitBitmapFlags when level, VideoMode_BlitRotated by the negated roll otherwise. es2_xref.py finds no reference to it.

entries.name: Hzline_LoadBitmapBank
entries.description: (self, name): loads the named resource from the folder PTR_DAT_004a0a28 names (the 'dba' folder Terrain_BindTextureBank uses) and stores it at +0x50, which Hzline_Ctor zeroes. es2_xref.py finds no reference to it.

entries.name: Hzline_Dtor
entries.description: hzline vtable +0x18 (0049afb0, the sky backdrop Hzline_Ctor builds), the destructor its class record names: (hzline, flags). One RTL destructor-count decrement, TSGroup_Dtor(hzline, 0), then Mem_Delete on flags bit 0.
entries.source: DBSIM disassembly at 0042f6d2; class record at 0042f682

entries.name: TexPoly_Ctor
entries.description: (poly, bankName, pointCount): TexPoly's constructor and the installer of its vtable 0049afe6: stamps ClassItem, TSBase, TSGroupItem, TSPoly, TSSolidPoly, TSTexture4Poly and TexPoly vtables in turn (five live destructors counted, a sixth at the end); vector-news five Point3I at +0x25; allocates pointCount*4 Point3I to +0xe, pointCount Point3S to +0x12 and pointCount zeroed bytes to +0x16, storing pointCount at +0x23 and +0xfd; loads bankName from the 004a0a28 folder with Resource_Load to +0x1a and BitmapArray_PackToAtlas of it to +0x1e; zeroes +0x61..+0x6c, the five points and +0x71..+0x7c, and clears +0x22 (TexPoly_SetupRings' done flag). No caller found by es2_xref.

entries.name: TexPoly_RandomPointOnCircle
entries.description: TexPoly vtable +0x24 (0049afe6), (poly, outPoint, outAngles, _, centre, radius, shift): draws a BAM angle a with Math_RandomNext, writes the Euler triple (0, 0, a) to outAngles, and outPoint = (centre.x + (Q14(radius, cos a) << shift), centre.y + (Q14(radius, cos(a - 0x4000)) << shift), poly+0x79).

entries.name: TexPoly_SetQuadAndRadius
entries.description: (poly, width, height, z, radius): stores width at +0x71 (the ring step TexPoly_SetupRings divides by), height at +0x75, z at +0x79 and radius at +0x6d, and writes the face's first four points (Point3I at +0x25 stride 12) as the rectangle (0,0)-(width,height) at height z: x of points 1 and 2 = width, y of points 2 and 3 = height, z of points 0-3 = z. No caller found by es2_xref.

entries.name: TexPoly_SetFifthVertex
entries.description: (poly, point): copies the Point3I point into +0x55, the fifth of the five face points at +0x25 that TexPoly_DrawAtPoints installs as DAT_006c6970. No caller found by es2_xref.

entries.name: TexPoly_SetupRings
entries.description: TexPoly vtable +0x20 (0049afe6), (poly, rect): ring count +0xf9 = +0x6d / +0x71 (the step); for ring i the radius step * (i + 1) + step / 2 at +0x9f[i], the int16 0xffff / ((step * (i + 1) * 4) / +0x75) at +0x81[i], and a Math_RandomNext angle at +0xdb[i]; then copies the rect's +4/+8/+0xc into +0xff/+0x103/+0x107 and sets +0x22.

entries.name: TexPoly_DrawAtPoints
entries.description: TexPoly's vtable (0049afe6, RTTI 'TexPoly' at 004302aa, base TSTexture4Poly) slot +0x34, a slot TSTexture4Poly does not have; es2_xref finds the vtable entry and no call. Runs slot +0x20 (0042f970) first while +0x22 is clear; installs g_CurrentShapeDbaContext = this+0x1a, the surface base 006c697a = this+0x61 and 006c6976 = 006c60ec; Raster_SetDepthFadeFromDistance(0), and holds DAT_004a09ac at 1 until it returns. Then for each of the +0x23 12-byte points at +0xe: when the viewer (arg+4) has moved since the last call (+0xff/+0x103), a point not flagged in the byte array at +0x16 and farther than +0x6d + +0x7d is reflected through the midpoint of the old and new viewer positions and flagged, and a flagged point nearer than +0x6d - +0x7d is unflagged; each point below index +0xfd gets slot +0x28 with its distance, Raster_SetModelTransform at its position and slot +0x2c (TexPoly_Render). Stores the viewer position at +0xff..+0x107.

entries.name: TexPoly_Render
entries.description: TexPoly's vtable (0049afe6) slot +0x2c, which TexPoly_DrawAtPoints calls once per point. Normally builds the poly's quad from the frame descriptor g_CurrentShapeDbaContext[1] + surface*0x14 (surface base 006c697a, index this+0xc) and hands it to Raster_SetupTexturedSpan, as TSTexture4Poly_Render does; while g_TexturedPolyUseBitmapBrush is set it takes the bitmap of the surface's +0 field when Raster_FrontFacing on the points this+4/+6 is positive and of its +8 field otherwise, and draws through Poly_ProjectIndexedVertices and PolyFill_FillThenOutline, calling slot +0x30 when the projection reports a vertex behind the near plane.

entries.name: TexPoly_ClipPolygon
entries.description: TexPoly vtable +0x30 (0049afe6), (poly, pairsIn, pairsOut): walks the current polygon's DAT_006c6968 vertices (indices at DAT_006c6976 + DAT_006c696a*2) edge by edge against the per-vertex code at DAT_006c697e, keeping a vertex coded 2 and, on an edge with one end coded 2, inserting the crossing at depth DAT_006c60b0 -- position interpolated with Math_Mul32To64/Math_DivMod64 and offset by DAT_006c60b8/DAT_006c60bc into 006cbb86/006cbb8a, and the vertex's 8-byte pair from pairsIn interpolated the same way into pairsOut. Returns the output count, also left in DAT_006cbc86.

entries.name: TexPoly_Dtor
entries.description: TexPoly vtable +0x18 (0049afe6, RTTI 'TexPoly', 0x10b bytes, derived from TSTexture4Poly), the destructor its class record names: (poly, flags). Five RTL destructor-count decrements, TSBase_Dtor(poly, 0), then Mem_Delete on flags bit 0.
entries.source: DBSIM disassembly at 004302fa; class record at 004302aa

entries.name: TexPoly_Slot28NoOp
entries.description: TexPoly vtable +0x28 (0049afe6): an empty body.

entries.name: Palette_LoadResources
entries.description: The palette module's subsystem phase-2 loader, registered by the _INIT_ routine at Palette_RegisterSubsystem (00430e90) (Borland _INIT_ entry 004a7b0a; PUSH 0x43034c at 00430e92): g_ShadeRamps (0049b034) = Mem_NewArray(0x408), 0x81 8-byte {int16 *indices, int16 count} entries, each given a 0x102-byte index buffer; then zeroes the five dwords at 004cfde8 (Palette_CycleAnimatedRanges' descriptors). It lies outside every Ghidra function.

entries.name: Palette_LoadAndActivate
entries.description: (path): ClassItem_LoadFromFile(path) into ActivePaletteObject, the live palette. World_LoadTheater calls it with dpl\world<N>; docs/retail/rendering/cockpit-canopy-palette.md#palette.

entries.name: Palette_SetActive
entries.description: (palette): makes palette the active palette ActivePaletteObject and returns the previous one. es2_xref finds calls from Palette_ActivateImpact (0042ea44), Palette_ToggleImpact (0042ea70), Palette_RestoreFromImpact (0042ea94) and two from CockpitViewManager_LoadViews.

entries.name: Palette_InstallRange
entries.description: (base, count, source): copies count dwords from source into the active palette's entries (ActivePaletteObject +8) from index base, and widens the dirty range 0049b028..0049b02c over base..base + count - 1, starting it afresh and setting the flag 0049b030 when the flag is clear.

entries.name: Palette_ReadRange
entries.description: (start, count, out): copies count dword entries of the active palette (ActivePaletteObject +8) from index start into out; the read-back of Palette_InstallRange (004303c4). es2_xref finds no branch or stored pointer to it.

entries.name: Palette_GetEntry
entries.description: (index): returns the active palette's dword entry at index (ActivePaletteObject +8). es2_xref finds no branch or stored pointer to it.

entries.name: Palette_FlushDirtyRange
entries.description: No arguments: when ActivePaletteObject differs from the palette last uploaded (0049b024), Palette_UploadWhole (00481ed4) of it, recording it there; otherwise, when the dirty flag 0049b030 is set, Palette_SetDisplayEntries (00465bc0) of it, all 256 entries, the range 0049b028..0049b02c unread. Then clears the range and the flag. es2_xref finds calls from Sim_EndFrame (two), CockpitViewManager_LoadViews and Sim_InitMissionSession (two).

entries.name: Palette_ReadShadeRampRanges
entries.description: (first, count, out): for count shade ramps from index first in g_ShadeRamps, writes {first palette index (*ramp.indices), ramp.count} as an int16 pair into out -- the read-back of Palette_SetRampsToRange (00430518)'s contiguous install. No caller found by es2_xref.

entries.name: Palette_SetRampsToRange
entries.description: (first, count, range{int16 start, int16 length}): for each of count records of g_ShadeRamps from index first, writes the consecutive indices start .. start+length-1 into the record's array (+0) and length into +4. The range pointer is read for every record without advancing, so all count records get the same range. Then Raster_SetColourRamps (00486d04)(first, count, records) copies the records into the raster's ramp table at g_RasterColourRamps (004a4fbd). Callers found by es2_xref: WorldShades_ApplyForObject (0042e8e8) and WorldShades_ResetRamps (0042ea0c) (twice; WorldShades_ResetRamps (0042ea0c) passes count 1 and range {0x10, 0x10} for ramps 0, 2, .. 12 and 0x18).

entries.name: Palette_SetRampsToRangeList
entries.description: (first, count, specs): for each of count records of g_ShadeRamps from index first, reads a 6-byte spec {int16 rangeCount; ranges**} (spec i, and the i-th pointer of that spec's pointer array), concatenates rangeCount contiguous {int16 start, int16 length} runs into the record's index array as consecutive indices, and stores the summed length at +4; then Raster_SetColourRamps (00486d04)(first, count, records) copies the records into the raster's ramp table at g_RasterColourRamps (004a4fbd). Caller found by es2_xref: WorldShades_ApplyForObject (0042e8e8), which passes count 1 and rangeCount 2.

entries.name: PaletteCycle_Register
entries.description: (record): stores record in the first empty slot of the five at 004cfde8, its due time (Time_GetCoarseTicks + record's int16 +4) at 004cfdfc and 0 at 004cfe10, returning 1; 0 when all five are taken. Palette_CycleAnimatedRanges walks the slots. World_LoadTheater registers each record of the theater's cyc file, reading three int16s per record but stepping 12 bytes through a count*6-byte buffer; no .CYC entry is in any retail VOL (name scan of the eleven, which finds the .WLD/.RMP entries).

entries.name: PaletteCycle_Unregister
entries.description: (record): clears the first of PaletteCycle_Register (00430638)'s five slots (004cfde8) holding record. es2_xref finds no branch or stored pointer to it.

entries.name: Palette_CycleAnimatedRanges
entries.description: No arguments: with Time_GetCoarseTicks as now, for each of the five slots (004cfde8) holding a record {int16 first, int16 count, int16 delay} whose due time (004cfdfc) is below now: copies count entries of the live palette (ActivePaletteObject +8) from first, starting at the slot's offset (004cfe10) and wrapping at count, to a stack buffer, installs them at first with Palette_InstallRange (004303c4), advances the offset by 1 (0 at count) and sets the due time to now + delay. Each step reads the entries the step before rewrote, so successive steps turn the range by 0, 1, 2, ... entries. es2_xref finds two calls, from Sim_EndFrame.

entries.name: Palette_InterpolateColours
entries.description: (from, to, count, levels, out): for each of count color pairs, levels - 1 colors from from's, each channel (read as a signed byte) stepping by ((to - from) * 256) / (levels - 1), truncated to int16, in 8.8 fixed point, each written with 0x01 in its top byte; then to's dword unchanged. es2_xref finds no branch or stored pointer to it.

entries.name: Palette_BeginCrossFade
entries.description: (from, to, duration): stores from (004cfe1c) and duration (004cfe24), clears the step timer's armed flag (0049b03c), and over the palette's int16 entry count (+4) fills per-channel int16 deltas at 004cfe28, 004d0028 and 004d0228: with a null from, to's channel * 256 / duration, mode (004d0428) 0; with a null to, from's channel * 256 / -duration, mode 1; with both, (to - from) * 256 / duration, mode 2. Stores the count at 004cfe22. Either endpoint null means a fade from or to black. es2_xref finds calls from LiftStart_DarkenPalette and two from Sim_DeathFlash.

entries.name: Palette_StepCrossFade
entries.description: No arguments: steps the Palette_BeginCrossFade (004308fc) fade by the coarse ticks elapsed since its first call. The first call after it arms an end time (0049b038) of Time_GetCoarseTicks + duration; once now passes the end it disarms and returns 0, writing nothing, so the last colors written are the last call's before the end rather than the destination. Otherwise, with e = duration - (end - now), writes the entry count of colors into the live palette from entry 004cfe20: mode 0 delta * e >> 8 per channel, modes 1 and 2 from's entry plus delta * e >> 8 per channel byte; widens the dirty range over them and returns end - now. A grep of the disassembly by address finds three reads of 004cfe20 and no store. es2_xref finds calls from LiftStart_Rise and two from Sim_DeathFlash.

entries.name: Palette_InterpolateIndexRanges
entries.description: Palette_InterpolateIndexRanges(from, to, rampCount, levels, out): linearly interpolates palette index RANGES, not colours. Each of from/to/out is an array of (int16 start, int16 count) pairs; for each of rampCount ramps it emits `levels` interpolated ranges in 8.8 fixed point, with the final step forced exactly to the `to` endpoint. Called twice by World_LoadTheater with endpoint tables read from WORLD<n>.WLD. WORLD0 expands to 11 ramps x 16 levels, all ranges within indices 96-239 (terrain shading only; no cockpit equivalent found).

entries.name: Palette_ShadeRampMidIndex
entries.description: (value): returns 0 when ActivePaletteObject+0x0c (the ramp count) is 0; otherwise ramp = ActivePaletteObject+0x10 + (value & 0xff) * 8 and returns the int16 palette index at ramp.indices[ramp.length (int16 at +4) >> 1], the middle entry of that shade ramp. Unlike Palette_ShadeRampLookup it does not clamp the ramp number against the count. No caller found by es2_xref.

entries.name: Palette_ShadeRampLookup
entries.description: Palette_ShadeRampLookup(value, shade): idx = value & 0xff, clamped to 0 when >= ActivePaletteObject+0x0c (the ramp count); reads ActivePaletteObject+0x10 as an array of 8-byte {int16* indices, int32 length} shade ramps and returns ramp[idx].indices[ Math_Q8Multiply(shade, length) ], stepping back one when that lands on the end. So a value here is a RAMP NUMBER, not a colour: the ramps are per-material brightness sequences of palette indices. They live in the tail of each .DPL, after the 256 colour entries. Sole consumer found: TSShadedPoly_Render.

entries.name: Palette_RegisterSubsystem
entries.description: Static initialiser of the palette module (Borland _INIT_ entry 004a7b0a, priority 0x20): RegisterSubsystemLoader(Palette_LoadResources, 2). Palette_LoadResources (0043034c) allocates g_ShadeRamps (0x81 records of 8 bytes, each with a 0x102-byte index array) and clears the five PaletteCycle_Register slots at 004cfde8.

entries.name: Cockpit_CreateCanvasContext
entries.description: (rect): the cockpit's canvas render context: allocates 0x239 bytes with Mem_New, builds a GLViewport there with GLViewport_Ctor, stores it at 004d042c, sets its clip mode +0x208 and its translation +0x20c to 1, copies rect's four dwords to +0x210..+0x21c, clears the byte +0x230 and the dword +0x231, sets +0x235 to 200 and returns the context. Gau_BuildCockpitWidgets (00431bf8) passes {0, 0, CockpitCanvasWidth - 1, 004d25d6 - 1} and stores the result at the cockpit's +4.

entries.name: Panel_LoadWrapper
entries.description: (path): opens path with VolRStream_CtorFromPath on a stack stream, loads one class item from it with ClassItem_LoadResource(stream, 0), destroys the stream with VolRStream_Dtor(stream, 2) and returns the item. ColorSchemePanels_LoadAll (00431098) loads its fonts through it.

entries.name: Cursor_LoadWrapper
entries.description: (path): the code of Panel_LoadWrapper (00430f58): opens path with VolRStream_CtorFromPath, loads one class item with ClassItem_LoadResource(stream, 0), destroys the stream and returns the item. ColorSchemePanels_LoadAll (00431098) loads its cursors through it.

entries.name: CockpitView_Ctor
entries.description: (cockpit, machine): clears the int16 +0x218 and sets +0x214 to maybe_GlobalLiveObjectList, stores the machine at +0x203 and the int16 +0x6c of its type record (+0x1f2) at +0x201, runs ColorSchemePanels_LoadAll (00431098)(cockpit), then stores a 16-byte Mem_NewArray at 004d0490 and a 48-byte one at 004d0494 holding four 12-byte records {0, a 16-byte array, a 16-byte array}. Returns the cockpit.

entries.name: ColorSchemePanels_LoadAll
entries.description: (cockpit): passes Language_StringFilePath(strings0, str)'s path to SimStrings_LoadAll. While ColorSchemePanels (0049b0ac) is 0 loads the 18 fonts of the name table 0049b108 (cpblue first) from hfn when VideoMode_PanelMode is 3 and from dfn otherwise, with Panel_LoadWrapper (00430f58). While Cockpit_CursorImages (0049b08c) is 0 loads the seven cursors of the name table 0049b150 from dci with Cursor_LoadWrapper (00430fb0), then stores cursor 1 (pcursor) at +0x236 and cursor 0 at +0x23a. Zeroes the three g_SquadmateMachines (004d044c), calls _memset(cockpit + 0xa20, 0x284, 0), stores the cockpit in CockpitViewInstance (0049b088) when that is 0, clears the byte +0x20f, the dword +0x226, the byte +0x245, the dword +0x241 and the byte +0x26a, and sets the int16 +0x23f to -1.

entries.name: Cockpit_PushCanvasContext
entries.description: (): adds 1 to the index byte 0049b106, saves the installed render context (006c5ff4) in the dword stack 004d0470 at that index, installs CockpitViewInstance's +4, the cockpit's canvas context, with Raster_InstallRenderContext and returns it. Cockpit_PopRenderContext (00431210) undoes it.

entries.name: Cockpit_PopRenderContext
entries.description: (): reinstalls the render context Cockpit_PushCanvasContext (004311e0) saved at 004d0470[0049b106] with Raster_InstallRenderContext and takes 1 from the index byte 0049b106.

entries.name: Widget_DrawToCockpit
entries.description: (which, rect, offset): copies a widget's rect between the display's two pages. Returns 0 unless Display_UseScrollWindow is 0, CockpitView_RectCornerVisible (00431410)(rect) passes and the published view manager's byte +0x1c is 0. With the display at 006c5f54, which = 1 copies from its +0x8c to its +0x88 and returns 0 while 004d25ae is set; any other value copies from +0x88 to +0x8c. Inside Cockpit_PushCanvasContext and Cockpit_PopRenderContext it stores the source page at the display's +0x38 and the draw page at +0x3c, each also through the raster routines' source- and draw-page slots; builds a region of the rect with its far corner one pixel further on each axis whose coordinate shift is above 0 and every corner less 004d25da/004d25de; copies it with Region_CopyBetweenPages at the offset, Cockpit_ZeroOffset when that is null, between the hide- and show-cursor slots; puts the draw page back and returns 1.

entries.name: CockpitView_RectCornerVisible
entries.description: (rect{x0, y0, x1, y1}): 0 when the cockpit's widgets are off (CockpitViewInstance+0x20f). Otherwise 1 when either corner (x0, y0) or (x1, y1), less 004d25da/004d25de, lies inside the box whose origin is the canvas context's (CockpitViewInstance+4) +0x210 + +0x220 across and +0x214 + +0x224 down and whose size is 004d25c2 x 004d25c6, bounds inclusive; 0 when neither does.

entries.name: CockpitView_DisableWidgets
entries.description: (view): sets the widgets-off byte view+0x20f to 1 when it is 0, the counterpart of CockpitView_EnableWidgets (00431518). CockpitView_ApplyViewState calls it on the manager's +0x1f cockpit when it switches to view 4.

entries.name: CockpitView_EnableWidgets
entries.description: (view): clears the widgets-off byte +0x20f when it is set. CockpitView_ApplyViewState calls it leaving view 4, and CockpitView_ProcessViewCommand on command 6.

entries.name: Cockpit_LoadSquadmatePilots
entries.description: (cockpit): walks GlobalMechList with Pool_Prev to the first machine whose byte +0xa3 is set, keeps its group +0x45 at 0049b0f8, and takes up to three of the group's members (the array +0xc, int16 count +0x10, stopping at a null) other than the cockpit's machine +0x203 into g_SquadmateMachines (004d044c). For each calls HddGauge_LoadPilotFrames(the cockpit's +0x1f9, slot, the member's int16 +0x29c), then MfdDisplay_SetStatusRoster(the cockpit's +0x1ed, count).

entries.name: Squad_SendOrderToSlot
entries.description: The [F7] command display's XMIT: addresses one squadmate by comm-box slot out of g_SquadmateMachines, stamps the record's issuer field at +0x02 with the player's machine (view+0x203), and calls that machine's vtable +0x28. Skips an empty slot, the player's own machine and a destroyed pilot; withdraws message 0x22 from the pilot-and-squad port (view+0x207) either way. Args derived from disassembly: [EBP+8], [EBP+0xc], [EBP+0x10].
entries.signature: void __cdecl Squad_SendOrderToSlot(int cockpitView, SquadOrderRecord *order, short slot)

entries.name: Squad_BroadcastOrderFromCockpit
entries.description: Stamps the order record's issuer field at +0x02 with the player's machine (view+0x203) and hands it to Squad_BroadcastOrder against the player's group (DAT_0049b0f8), leaving that call's result in EAX untouched, so it returns whether anyone accepted; MfdFlashComm_Transmit tests it. Args derived from disassembly: [EBP+8], [EBP+0xc].

entries.name: Squad_CallsignOf
entries.description: (machine): walks the three g_SquadmateMachines slots and returns the matching slot's entry of SquadCallsignStrings (004d1424, STRINGS0.STR group 7: RED 1, RED 2, RED 3); otherwise 0. No caller found by es2_xref.

entries.name: CockpitView_InvalidateWidgets
entries.description: (cockpit): unless the widgets are off (+0x20f), calls vtable slot +4 (a widget's Invalidate) on each non-null widget pointer: the ten at +0x70 and those at +0x1e1, +0x1e5, +0x1e9, +0x1f1, +0x1ed and +0x1f9 inside Cockpit_PushCanvasContext / Cockpit_PopRenderContext, then +0x1f5 after the pop. CockpitView_SetView runs it after blitting the canopy.
entries.source: DBSIM decompile at 004316c0; slot +4 from known_vtables.json CockpitWidgetVtable

entries.name: Gau_Load
entries.description: PANEL.CPP's .GAU loader. Allocates a 1700-byte (0x6a4) struct -- the .GAU's content size -- then vector-constructs six arrays of 16-byte rects, counts 10, 3, 4, 13, 15 and 3: the first, the 10 weapon-row rects at +0x14 (.GAU offset 20, stride 16), with GauWeaponRect_ElementCtor, the other five with RectI_Ctor. Reads the file over it, and when the origin offset (ints 0 and 1) is non-zero adds it to the first n weapon-row rects, n being the int at +0x10, and to seven other rects (ints 0x75, 0x89, 0x9a, 0xb6, 0xfa, 0x110, 0x12f). See docs/retail/formats/gau-cockpit-layout.md.

entries.name: Gau_BuildCockpitWidgets
entries.description: Loads the .GAU through Gau_Load, then builds the cockpit's widget tree, and the order it does so in IS the flat clickable list's order, which first-hit-wins makes into precedence: SystemButtons_Ctor's two system gadgets, then the pilot message port at +0x207 from .GAU 1668 (DialogPort_Ctor, or TrainingMessagePort_Ctor with the rect lifted by the int at 1664 in a training mission) and the computer's message port at +0x20b from 1684, then the seven top-level gauges from fixed literal .GAU offsets (468 console buttons, 548 energy meter, 616 shields, 728 MFD, 1000 throttle, 1088 roving gunsight, 1212 heads-down display) stored at cockpit+0x1e1..+0x1f9, then calls Gau_ShiftRects3Point, Gau_ShiftRects3 and Gau_ShiftRects5 on ints 0x41, 0x2d and 0x59 and shifts the first n weapon-row rects (n the int at +0x10) by VideoMode_X/YCoordShift, then WeaponMounts_BuildGauges for the weapon rows. Ends with the flyer branch: when the piloted machine's type record has a non-zero +0x50 (InputFlagFlyer, the RAZOR alone) it sets cockpit+0x245 and both arms and immediately latches (+0x8d = 1) the ten gauges at cockpit+0x70 and the three widgets at +0x1e9/+0x1f5/+0x1ed, so none of them plays its power-up animation.

entries.name: CockpitView_RegisterWeaponGauge
entries.description: (cockpit, gauge, row): for a row of -1 takes the first null slot of the ten at +0x70; stores gauge at +0x1d8 when that is 0, at the widget list +8 + 4 x the count +0x6c and at +0x70 + 4 x row, and adds 1 to +0x6c and to +0x98. Each weapon-row gauge factory ends with it.

entries.name: CockpitView_CreateEnergyWeaponGauge
entries.description: (view, row, mount): copies the 16 bytes at CockpitGauRecord+0x14+row*0x10 to CockpitGauRecord+0x104, allocates 0xdf bytes, runs EnergyWeaponGauge_Ctor(gauge, record+0x104, view, row, mount) and CockpitView_RegisterWeaponGauge(view, gauge, row), and returns the gauge.

entries.name: CockpitView_CreateAmmoWeaponGauge
entries.description: (view, row, mount): copies the 16 bytes at CockpitGauRecord+0x14+row*0x10 to CockpitGauRecord+0xb4, allocates 0xef bytes, runs AmmoWeaponGauge_Ctor(gauge, record+0xb4, view, row, mount) and CockpitView_RegisterWeaponGauge(view, gauge, row), and returns the gauge. CockpitView_CreateEnergyWeaponGauge's ammunition twin;

entries.name: CockpitView_CreatePodGauge
entries.description: (view, row, pod): builds the cockpit weapon-row gauge for one equipment pod. Copies the 16 bytes at CockpitGauRecord+0x14+row*0x10 to CockpitGauRecord+0x164 and builds from there, switching on the pod's catalog id at pod+0x77: 0x12 (ECM) gets TogglePodGauge_Ctor, 0x1f (TURB) gets TurboPodGauge_Ctor, and 0x1d, 0x1e and 0x20 (TARG, SHLD, ENRG) get the plain PodGauge_Ctor; then CockpitView_RegisterWeaponGauge at the row.
entries.signature: int __cdecl CockpitView_CreatePodGauge(int cockpitView, short hardpoint, void *pod)

entries.name: Gau_WeaponButtonsWidget
entries.description: (cockpit, record): .GAU block 468 (+0x1d4): shifts it with GauWeaponButtons_ApplyCoordShift, builds a 0xb5-byte ConsoleButtons over it with ConsoleButtons_Ctor(panel, block, cockpit), calls ConsoleButtons_SetChainNumber(panel, 2), sets the byte +0x1e0 to 1, the dword +0x1d4 to 0 and +0x1d8 to the dword at +0x16c, appends the panel to the widget list +8 (count +0x6c) and returns it.

entries.name: Gau_EnergyMeterWidget
entries.description: (panel, gauBlock): the .GAU offset 548 widget wrapper. Runs GauEnergyMeter_ApplyCoordShift on the block at +0x224 (offset 548, the panel rect and its one child, the energy meter's rect at 564), allocates 0xc3 bytes and builds an EnergyPoolGauge over the block (EnergyPoolGauge_Ctor), and appends it to the panel's child array (+8, count +0x6c).

entries.name: Gau_ShieldDisplayWidget
entries.description: (cockpit, record): .GAU block 616 (+0x268): shifts it with ShieldsGauge_ApplyCoordShift, builds a 0xd4-byte ShieldsGauge over it with ShieldsGauge_Ctor(gauge, block, cockpit), appends the gauge to the widget list +8 (count +0x6c) and returns it.

entries.name: Gau_MfdPanelWidget
entries.description: (cockpit, record): .GAU block 728 (+0x2d8): shifts it with MfdGau_ApplyCoordShift, builds a 0x349-byte MFD over it with MfdDisplay_Ctor(display, block, cockpit), appends it to the widget list +8 (count +0x6c), calls MfdDisplay_SetMode(display, 3) and returns it.

entries.name: Gau_ThrottleWidget
entries.description: (cockpit, record): .GAU block 1000 (+0x3e8): shifts it with GauThrottle_ApplyCoordShift, builds a 0xca-byte ThrottleGauge over it with ThrottleGauge_Ctor(gauge, block, cockpit), appends the gauge to the widget list +8 (count +0x6c) and returns it.

entries.name: Gau_RovingGunsightWrapper
entries.description: (cockpit, record): .GAU block 1088 (+0x440): shifts it with GauRovingGunsight_ApplyCoordShift, builds the 0x11b-byte gunsight complex over it with Gau_RovingGunsightWidget(object, block, cockpit), appends it to the widget list +8 (count +0x6c) and returns it.

entries.name: Gau_PilotRosterWidget
entries.description: (cockpit, record): .GAU block 1212 (+0x4bc): shifts it with HddGau_ApplyCoordShift, builds the 0x78a-byte Heads-Down Display over it with HddDisplay_Ctor(display, block, cockpit), appends it to the widget list +8 (count +0x6c) and returns it.

entries.name: Gau_PanelAmbienceWidget
entries.description: (cockpitView, gauRecord): .GAU offset 1604 (0x644) widget wrapper, the same shape as Gau_PilotRosterWidget: shifts the block at gauRecord+0x644 with Gau_ShiftRects2Point (00452274) (VideoMode_ShiftRect on its rect, then three x/y pairs at +0x10..+0x24 by VideoMode_X/YCoordShift), builds a 0xc1-byte PanelAmbience over it with PanelAmbience_Ctor(gauge, block, cockpitView), and appends the gauge to the view's widget array (+8, count +0x6c). No caller found by es2_xref; the rect and pairs at .GAU 1604 are zero in all nine retail .GAU files.

entries.name: CockpitWidgets_TranslateForView
entries.description: (cockpitView, delta): re-places the cockpit's widgets for a view change. Calls Widget_TranslateRootForView, through its thunk, on the root *cockpitView; subtracts the delta from the dwords +0x220/+0x224 of the render context at cockpitView+4; when the one-shot build flag +0x23e is set hands the delta to CockpitView_FlipScrollTriggers, which moves the three screen-edge strips; then offsets each widget of the list at +0x246 (count +0x25a) by -delta with Widget_OffsetRect. CockpitView_ApplyViewState calls it leaving a glance with that view's own origin and otherwise with the outgoing view's origin less the incoming one's; CockpitView_StepShake and CockpitView_ClearShake call it with the shake's step.

entries.name: CockpitView_PerFrameUpdate
entries.description: (cockpit): the cockpit's per-frame pass; does nothing while the byte 0049b104 is set. The first time (+0x23e clear) calls CockpitView_BuildScrollTriggers and sets +0x23e; calls Cockpit_PowerUpTick while +0x245 is clear, then Cockpit_HitShakeTick and Cockpit_StepKickTick. With the widgets on (+0x20f clear) calls vtable slot +0x14 of the pilot channel +0x207; between Cockpit_PushCanvasContext and Cockpit_PopRenderContext calls slot +8 of each set gauge of the ten at +0x70 and of +0x1e1, +0x1e5, +0x1e9, +0x1f1, +0x1ed and +0x1f9; then Cockpit_UpdateEdgeCursor, clears the selection +0x210 when it is set and TargetSelect_CanTarget(cockpit, it) returns 0, WidgetRoot_ServicePressFlashes(the root +0) and NavMarker_Tick. With the widgets off it calls slot +8 of +0x1f9 alone.

entries.name: Cockpit_PowerUpSound
entries.description: The cockpit's power-up audio. Plays Sound_Play(0x13) -- start3, the start-up sequence -- once per session, gated on cockpit+0x245 and stamping cockpit+0x241 with Time_GetCoarseTicks. Then, ONLY when the piloted machine's type record (mech+0x1f2) has a nonzero +0x50 -- file offset 78, InputFlagFlyer, the RAZOR alone -- starts the looping engine hum Sound_Play(0x2d) and immediately drops it with Sound_SetPitch(0x2d, 42000), about 0.64 of its recorded rate. Despite the sample being called herceng1, a walking HERC never plays it; its running noise is its footsteps.

entries.name: Cockpit_PowerUpTick
entries.description: The cockpit power-up sequence, gated on the start tick Cockpit_PowerUpSound stamps at cockpit+0x241 (nothing runs while it is 0); elapsed is Time_GetCoarseTicks() minus it, compared unsigned. Each pass arms any widget not yet armed (widget+0x8c clear) with Widget_BeginPowerUpAnimation: the ten weapon-row gauges at cockpit+0x70 each once elapsed exceeds its own delay from PowerUp_RowArmDelays, and cockpit+0x1e9, +0x1f5 (the roving gunsight) and +0x1ed as soon as elapsed is non-zero. Separately, once elapsed exceeds 200, sets cockpit+0x245, reads internals 0-9 of the machine at cockpit+0x203 with Mech_ReadEntryDamage (kind 0) and posts message 0x22 POWERUP INITIATED. INTERNAL DAMAGE DETECTED. at the first nonzero reading, else 0x21 ... ALL SYSTEMS NOMINAL., through the computer's message port at cockpit+0x20b (its vtable slot 0, given a record whose first word is the id). A nonzero reading also goes through Damage_ToConditionState and is tested against 0x5a, but that returns a condition index of 0-4, so the test always passes. At 16 ms a coarse tick that lands 3.2 s in, inside start3's five seconds rather than after them.

entries.name: CockpitView_ArmWeaponByGauge
entries.description: (cockpitView, gauge): WeaponMounts_SelectByGauge (004106ac) on the weapon manager +0x202 of the machine +0x203, returning 1 when that returns nonzero, else 0. es2_xref finds calls from CockpitWidgets_HandleCommand (00432bc8), EnergyWeaponGauge_OnChildClick and AmmoWeaponGauge_OnChildClick.

entries.name: CockpitView_SetConsoleButtonsLatch
entries.description: (cockpitView): sets the byte +0x1e0 to 1 and the dword +0x1d4 to 0 -- the two stores Gau_WeaponButtonsWidget makes after building the console buttons -- then runs the console panel's (+0x1e1) vtable +0x08, ConsoleButtons_Update. No caller found by es2_xref.

entries.name: CockpitView_UnlightConsoleButtons
entries.description: (cockpitView): clears the byte +0x1e0; for the console panel's (+0x1e1) children at +0x18, +0x1c and +0x20 (chain, LINK, TRACK) clears the child's lamp byte +0x40 (the lit state ConsoleButton_Paint reads for the TRACK kind) and invalidates it through its vtable +0x04 (Widget_InvalidateDeferred); then runs ConsoleButtons_Update. No caller found by es2_xref.

entries.name: CockpitView_PollViewDevice
entries.description: (cockpitView, device): with +0x23e set, Cockpit_PickEdgeCursor (00433b20)(cockpitView, device + 2); the device bytes +0x1e, +0x1f, +0x20 and +0x21 each queue view command 1, 0, 5 and 4 with CockpitView_QueueViewCommand on CockpitViewManager_Published's manager; when the byte +0xb is set and the latch 0049b550 was clear, in view 1 (the manager's +0x14) calls the +0xc slot (key) of the vtable of the Heads-Down Display +0x1f9 with 0x0f; the latch then follows +0xb. Returns 1 in AL. es2_xref finds one call, from Sim_PollPlayerInput.

entries.name: CockpitWidgets_HandleCommand
entries.description: (view, code): the cockpit widget tree's command handler. Returns 0 at once while the widgets are off (+0x20f). The view is CockpitViewManager_Published()+0x14. 0x27 (;) clears the selection (TargetSelect_SetObject(view, 0)). 0x0f (Tab) goes to the HDD's (+0x1f9) key slot (+0xc) in view 1, and otherwise steps the cockpit machine's (+0x203) Targeting Pod (+0x30b) with TargetingPod_CycleComponent. 0x01 (Esc) queues view command 0, 1 or 6 from views 0, 1 and 2-3. 0x02-0x0b, outside view 1, take the weapon gauge at +0x70 + (code-2)*4 and, when there is one, CockpitView_ArmWeaponByGauge then Widget_PressChild(gauge, 0, 1). 0x13 (R) runs Mech_ToggleRadarMode. 0x1c (Enter) returns 0 in view 4 and, outside view 1, presses MFD (+0x1ed) child 9 on mode 3, child 7 on mode 4, and runs TargetSelect_Cycle on any other mode. 0x3b-0x40 (F1-F6) press MFD child code-0x3b, then queue view command 1 from view 1 or 6 from views 2-3. 0x41-0x42 (F7, F8) press HDD child code-0x41 and, unless maybe_CockpitLayoutMode is 1, queue view command 0. 0x43 (F9) queues 5 from view 0 or 6 from view 2; 0x44 (F10) 4 from view 0 or 6 from view 3. 0x57 (F11) builds and runs an ObjectivesPanel. 0x220 (Alt+D) runs NavMarker_DropAtPlayer. Any other code goes to MfdFlashComm_HandleAltKey, then in view 1 to the HDD's key slot, and otherwise to the key slots of +0x1d8 (when set), +0x1e1, +0x1e5, +0x1e9, +0x1f1, +0x1f5 and +0x1ed, and of +0x1f9 when maybe_CockpitLayoutMode is 1, stopping at the first that returns nonzero. Returns 1 for a code it handled, 0 otherwise.

entries.name: Squad_IndexOf
entries.description: (object): the index 0-2 of object in the three-entry g_SquadmateMachines, or -1 for a null object or one absent from it. es2_xref finds nine calls, among them PilotMessagePort_Post, MfdStatusScreen_Paint, CommBox_OnMessageBegin and ViewChain_DrawCaption.

entries.name: CockpitView_GetSquadMessagePort
entries.description: Returns the pilot and squad message port at CockpitViewInstance+0x207, or 0 when there is no cockpit view.

entries.name: TargetSelect_CanTarget
entries.description: (view, object): 1 when the object is alive (+0x99 and +0xa4 clear), on the other side (its group's (+0x45) byte +0x12 against that of the measuring object's group), and known by either sensor route: radar-visible (+0x95) within DAT_004d1cfc, or a contact the measuring object holds (its byte +0xc2 + the object's int16 +0x4b) within Detection_ContactScanRange, each distance strictly less; else 0. The measuring object is the machine view+0x203, or ViewChain_Viewed while DAT_0049ef5c is set.

entries.name: TargetSelect_InForwardCone
entries.description: (view, object): with DAT_0049ef5c clear, Math_HeadingToward from the machine view+0x203's point +0x26 to the object's, less the machine's int16 +0x10, plus what the machine's vtable +0x3c slot returns; with it set, the heading from ViewChain_Viewed to the object less ViewChain_Viewed's +0x10. Returns 1 when that int16 lies in -8999..8999, else 0.

entries.name: TargetSelect_SetObject
entries.description: (view, object): object 0 clears the selection +0x210. Otherwise runs TargetSelect_Cycle (0043349c) when there is no selection, then steps +0x210 through maybe_GlobalLiveObjectList from the cursor +0x214 and its int16 index +0x218 (past the list's count the selection takes 0 and the cursor and index go back to the start) until +0x210 is the object, passes TargetSelect_CanTarget and the object passes TargetSelect_InForwardCone, or the walk is back at the selection it began with. When the selection is then the object (0 after a clear), sets the dword +6 of Gunsight_GetStateBlock (0043db88)(+0x1f5)'s block to it and the byte +0x24 to 1 and hands the block to Gunsight_SetValues (0043d98c). Returns whether the selection is the object. es2_xref finds calls from CockpitWidgets_HandleCommand and Gunsight_UpdateAndPaint.

entries.name: TargetSelect_Nearest
entries.description: (view): the nearest by 3D range from the machine view+0x203 of the live objects whose targetClass is 0 or 2 and that pass TargetSelect_CanTarget (00433174), with the cone test left out; when one is found and differs from the selection +0x210, it becomes the selection and goes to the gunsight +0x1f5 as in TargetSelect_SetObject (block dword +6, byte +0x24 = 1). Returns the object found, or 0. es2_xref finds calls from Sim_DispatchCommand and Sim_PollPlayerInput.

entries.name: TargetSelect_Cycle
entries.description: (view): files every live object that passes TargetSelect_CanTarget (00433174) and TargetSelect_InForwardCone (00433250) into one of four buckets at DAT_004d0494 by bearing error (the absolute heading error with turret twist, less a size correction, >> 10, clamped to 3), each bucket keeping its four nearest by range; flattens the buckets in order into the four-entry shortlist DAT_004d0490 points to; takes its head or, when the head is the previous head or the selection and there is a selection, the next set entry after the selection among the first three. A different result becomes the selection +0x210 and goes to the roving gunsight +0x1f5 through Gunsight_GetStateBlock and Gunsight_SetValues (block dword +6, byte +0x24 = 1). Returns +0x210. The size correction is Math_Q10Multiply of a literal 0 (PUSH 0x0 at 004335d0), so it is always 0. es2_xref finds calls from CockpitWidgets_HandleCommand, TargetSelect_SetObject, Cockpit_CycleTarget and Sim_PollPlayerInput.

entries.name: CockpitView_BuildScrollTriggers
entries.description: (view): builds the three ScrollTrigger strips: for each, Mem_New(0x24), Widget_CtorRect with the rect, CTLButtonControlVtable at +0x17 and 0 in the int16 +0x1d, then ScrollTriggerVtable at +0x17 and the view at +0x20; stores it and registers it with Widget_RegisterClickable on the root widget +0. With W and H the display's attributes 0 and 1 and X, Y VideoMode_XCoordShift and YCoordShift, the rects are {0, H-1-(3<<Y), W-1, H-1}, the bottom strip at +0x21a; {0, 0, 5<<X, H-1}, the left at +0x21e; and {W-1-(5<<X), 0, W-1, H-1}, the right at +0x222. es2_xref finds one call, from CockpitView_PerFrameUpdate (004327ac).

entries.name: CockpitView_FlipScrollTriggers
entries.description: (view, delta): per axis of the delta, 6 or more sets the sign +1 and a shift of the display's width (attribute 0) or height (attribute 1), below -5 the sign -1 and minus that shift, else neither. For each strip at +0x21a, +0x21e and +0x222, a set sign reflects the rect across its own edge on that axis (sign +1: x1 = x0, x0 -= width; sign -1: x0 = x1, x1 = x0 + width; likewise y), and the rect then moves by -(delta - shift) on both axes. es2_xref finds one call, from CockpitWidgets_TranslateForView. See docs/retail/simulation/cockpit-input.md.

entries.name: CockpitView_HandleEdgeTrigger
entries.description: (view, strip): by the published manager's view +0x14, queues with CockpitView_QueueViewCommand: for the bottom strip +0x21a command 0 from view 0 and 1 from view 1; for the left +0x21e 5 from view 0 and 6 from view 3; for the right +0x222 4 from view 0 and 6 from view 2; any other pair queues nothing. es2_xref finds one call, from ScrollTrigger_OnClick (00434df0). See docs/retail/simulation/cockpit-input.md.

entries.name: Cockpit_PickEdgeCursor
entries.description: (view, point): while Cockpit_CursorsLive is set: takes the point from Input_GetCursorPos (0045b734) instead under TapePlayback; rebases it as point - the canvas context's (+4) +0x210/+0x214 + its +0x220/+0x224; zeroes +0x22e and, for the first of the strips +0x21a, +0x21e, +0x222 whose rect holds the point (bounds inclusive), stores the arrow by the manager's view +0x14: the bottom 4 (scursor) in view 0 and 3 (ncursor) in view 1, the left 6 (wcursor) in view 0 and 5 (ecursor) in view 3, the right 5 in view 0 and 6 in view 2. es2_xref finds one call, from CockpitView_PollViewDevice.

entries.name: Cockpit_UpdateEdgeCursor
entries.description: (view): while Cockpit_CursorsLive is set: with an arrow at +0x22e, puts Cockpit_CursorImages[arrow] in the edge slot +0x232, makes it the active slot (+0x226) when it is not, saving the previous active slot at +0x22a, and calls maybe_Driver3_SetCursorImage while Display_UseScrollWindow is set, else maybe_Cursor_SetImage; with none, when the edge slot is active, puts the saved slot back and calls the same pair. es2_xref finds one call, from CockpitView_PerFrameUpdate.

entries.name: Cockpit_SetForwardCursor
entries.description: (index): while Cockpit_CursorsLive is set and index differs from the last one (0049b62c): puts Cockpit_CursorImages[index] in the forward-view slot +0x236 of CockpitViewInstance, calls maybe_Cursor_SetImage, or maybe_Driver3_SetCursorImage while Display_UseScrollWindow is set, when the active slot (+0x226) is other than the edge slot +0x232, and records the index. es2_xref finds two calls, from Gunsight_ClickSurface_Paint.

entries.name: Cockpit_SetOffForwardCursor
entries.description: (index): Cockpit_SetForwardCursor (00433d90) on the slot +0x23a of CockpitViewInstance, which Cockpit_UseOffForwardCursor activates, with its own last index (0049b630). es2_xref finds seven calls, three from HddDisplay_HandleWidgetPress, two from HddCommandScreen_SelectOrder, and from HddCommandScreen_Show and HddCommandScreen_Hide.

entries.name: Cockpit_UseOffForwardCursor
entries.description: No arguments: with c CockpitViewInstance, stores c + 0x23a at the saved slot +0x22a when c's active slot +0x226 holds the edge slot c + 0x232; otherwise makes c + 0x23a the active slot and passes the image on through maybe_Driver3_SetCursorImage on the scroll-window path and maybe_Cursor_SetImage on the paged one. CockpitView_StepViewTransition runs it at the end of a pan down and of every glance slide.

entries.name: Cockpit_UseForwardCursor
entries.description: No arguments: Cockpit_UseOffForwardCursor's code with c + 0x236, the forward cursor. es2_xref finds calls from CockpitView_StepViewTransition, at the end of a pan up, and Sim_InitMissionSession.
entries.source: DBSIM decompile at 00433f7c and its two callers

entries.name: Cockpit_StartHitShake
entries.description: Starts (or restarts) the cockpit's damage shake; returns at once when CockpitViewManager_Published's manager is in view 4 (+0x14). When HitShakeEndTick is set it first calls Palette_RestoreFromImpact and CockpitView_ClearShake. Sets HitShakeEndTick to now + 0x3c coarse ticks; when HitShakeNextToggleTick is 0 sets it to now + Math_RandomNext % 10, calls Palette_ActivateImpact and CockpitView_SetShakeBand(5 << VideoMode_YCoordShift). So a restart over a running shake restores the palette and clears the band, then skips the arm block because HitShakeNextToggleTick is still set, extending the window without re-seeding the band.

entries.name: Cockpit_HitShakeTick
entries.description: Per-frame half of the damage shake. In view 4 it clears HitShakeEndTick. While HitShakeEndTick is in the future it calls Palette_ToggleImpact each time HitShakeNextToggleTick has passed, rearming it at now + Math_RandomNext % 10, and CockpitView_StepShake(Math_RandomNext % 5) every frame, returning 1; at expiry it clears HitShakeEndTick and returns 1. With HitShakeEndTick clear and HitShakeNextToggleTick set it calls Palette_RestoreFromImpact, clears the toggle tick, calls CockpitView_ClearShake and returns 1; otherwise it returns 0.

entries.name: Cockpit_StartStepKick
entries.description: Restarts the view's step kick unless the view manager's mode (+0x14) is 4: CockpitView_ClearKickOffset, then StepKickStartTick = now and StepKickEndTick = now + 0x3c coarse ticks, and CockpitView_ForgetKickOffset. Mech_PlaceLegsOnGround calls it on a footfall of the locally piloted machine.

entries.name: Cockpit_StepKickTick
entries.description: Per frame from CockpitView_PerFrameUpdate, after Cockpit_HitShakeTick. Clears StepKickEndTick in view mode 4 or once now passes it; while it is ahead, CockpitView_SetKickOffset(StepKickCurve[(now - start) * 10 / 0x3c]), halved when VideoMode_YCoordShift is 0 and shifted left by YCoordShift - 1 otherwise, and returns 1. On the frame it expires, CockpitView_ClearKickOffset.

entries.name: Hud_WorldUnitsToMetres
entries.description: THE GAME'S UNIT SCALE, stated by the original itself: 'return (worldUnits / 1000) * 6', i.e. 1000 world units = 6 metres, one world unit = 6 mm, 166.667 units per metre. The integer divide truncates toward zero, so the figure is quantised to multiples of 6 m.

entries.name: Pilot_PortraitOf
entries.description: (pilot): pilot / 3, the division rounding toward zero. es2_xref finds one call, from HddGauge_LoadPilotFrames.

entries.name: Pilot_VoiceBankOf
entries.description: (portrait): portrait / 4 + 1, the division rounding toward zero, with 3 made 4. es2_xref finds calls from HddGauge_LoadPilotFrames and CommBox_BeginMessage.

entries.name: HudColorTable_Get
entries.description: (i): HudColorTable[0049b040[i]], sign-extended; the int16 ids at 0049b040 are 12, 15 and 26. es2_xref finds five calls, from PilotMessagePort_Speak, HddGauge_LoadPilotFrames, HddDamageScreen_SetSubjectCaption and twice from HddCommandScreen_DrawMarker.

entries.name: Squad_PilotName
entries.description: (slot): HddGauge_Name (0044b900)(the Heads-Down Display at CockpitViewInstance+0x1f9, slot), the name in comm-box slot slot. es2_xref finds calls from PilotMessagePort_ComposeLine and ViewChain_DrawCaption.

entries.name: PilotMessagePort_GetHqName
entries.description: Returns 004d1430, STRINGS0.STR group 8's one entry, HQ. PilotMessagePort_ComposeLine signs a line whose record names no speaker with it.

entries.name: Squad_SlotOfPilotName
entries.description: (name): HddGauge_FindByName (0044b928)(CockpitViewInstance+0x1f9, name), returning its result: the comm-box slot 0-2 whose pilot name (+0x137 of the slot's gauge) is a case-insensitive prefix of name (strnicmp over the slot name's length), or -1. The name-to-slot counterpart of Squad_PilotName. No caller found by es2_xref.

entries.name: Player_DependentCondition
entries.description: (n): Damage_ToConditionState (00438700) of the int16 Mech_ReadEntryDamage (0041b514)(the machine CockpitViewInstance+0x203, kind 0, index n) returns: condition 0-4 of the machine's kind-0 entry n. es2_xref finds six calls, from Gunsight_UpdateAndPaint, EnergyWeaponGauge_Update, AmmoWeaponGauge_Update, PodGauge_Update, MfdDisplay_Update and HddDisplay_Update.

entries.name: CockpitView_FindArmedMountGauge
entries.description: (cockpitView): the weapon gauge among the view's ten at +0x70 (count +0x98) whose mount (+0xbd) is the viewing machine's armed mount -- view+0x203 is the machine, its +0x202 the mount manager, whose +0x1d index into +4 is the armed mount, or 0 with the index negative -- or 0 when no gauge has it. es2_xref finds one call, from MfdDisplay_SyncMissileCamMode.

entries.name: SystemButtons_Ctor
entries.description: Registers the first two entries of the cockpit's clickable list, ahead of every gauge. Lazily loads the `sysbuttn` sprite bank into DAT_0049b63c (folder by VideoMode_PanelMode == 3), then builds two SystemGadgets from hardcoded coordinates rather than from the .GAU: x 305-317 and x 291-303, y 2-13 inclusive, in 320-wide units shifted by VideoMode_X/YCoordShift -- the screen's top-right corner, where CockpitWidgets_TranslateForView keeps them in every view. Frame 0 (a question mark) on the right-hand one, frame 1 (a window) on the left. Stored at cockpit+0x246 and +0x24a with the count 2 at +0x25a. Child 0 raises the on-line manual, child 1 toggles fullscreen -- see SystemButtons_OnChildClick.

entries.name: SystemButtons_PaintForPointer
entries.description: (cockpit, point): inside a Cockpit_PushCanvasContext pair, gives each system button (list cockpit+0x246, count +0x25a) state 0 when point.y plus the cockpit viewport's (004d042c) +0x224 lies within the button's y span (+4..+0xc) and state 3 otherwise, and paints it through its vtable slot 0. Sim_RenderFrame's last call, with the pointer position at 004d234c.

entries.name: SystemButtons_OnChildClick
entries.description: Owner slot 0 for both SystemGadgets. Matches the clicked widget against the pair at cockpit+0x246 by index and, unless a .TAP is replaying (TapePlayback), runs child 0 as OnlineManual_Raise followed by Help_Show and child 1 as Video_ToggleFullscreen followed by a repaint of the shield gauge at cockpit+0x1e9.

entries.name: SystemButtons_HideAll
entries.description: (cockpit): SystemGadget_SaveAndHide on each system button (list +0x246, count +0x25a). CockpitView_ProcessViewCommand runs it when its +0x1c is set.

entries.name: SystemButtons_RestoreAll
entries.description: (cockpit): SystemGadget_RestoreState on each system button (list +0x246, count +0x25a). CockpitView_StepViewTransition runs it.

entries.name: SystemGadget_Ctor
entries.description: Constructor for SystemGadget (object size 0x60), the on-line manual and fullscreen-toggle buttons at the screen's top-right corner; SystemButtons_Ctor builds both.
