Leaves the state byte at +0x1b holding 3 rather than 0, which Widget_HitTestChildren treats as clickable and SystemGadget_Paint draws as the art beneath. Class name from the descriptor record at 00434ced.

entries.name: SystemGadget_Paint
entries.description: SystemGadget's vtable +0. Blits the button's frame in state 0 after rebasing the rect through the widget render context, and in state 3 -- the state its constructor leaves it in -- restores the art underneath instead. Draws nothing in state 2.

entries.name: SystemGadget_OnClick
entries.description: SystemGadget's vtable +8. Forwards itself to SystemButtons_OnChildClick with the cockpit singleton; ignores the button flags the slot is called with.

entries.name: SystemGadget_SaveAndHide
entries.description: (gadget): saves the state +0x1b at +0x5c, sets state 3 and paints through vtable slot 0.

entries.name: SystemGadget_RestoreState
entries.description: (gadget): puts the state saved at +0x5c back in +0x1b and paints through vtable slot 0.

entries.name: NavMarker_Position
entries.description: Accessor for the cockpit nav marker's position: view+0x25e while the flag at view+0x26a is set, otherwise null. Called by Hud_UpdateWaypointIndicator (gunsight child 7's paint) and HddCommandScreen_DrawMap.

entries.name: NavMarker_DropAtPlayer
entries.description: Drops the cockpit's nav marker on the player machine's own position: copies mech+0x26 to view+0x25e, sets the marker flag at view+0x26a and clears the armed flag at +0x26b, so a marker dropped where the player stands cannot clear on the frame it appeared. Reached from CockpitWidgets_HandleCommand on command 0x220, which is [Alt+D].

entries.name: NavMarker_Tick
entries.description: The nav marker's whole lifecycle, run once a frame from the cockpit's own paint (CockpitView_PerFrameUpdate). With a marker down, takes the ground range to it: unarmed, leaving 10000 units arms it; armed, returning inside 10000 clears the marker and posts WAYPOINT REACHED (0x1d) to the computer's ticker.

entries.name: CockpitView_SetTargetBlock
entries.description: Writes the frame's target block into CockpitViewInstance+0x26c..+0x27e: the selected object, its world aim point (3 ints), and the two shorts Player_ResolveTargetAimPoint produced -- a component-present flag and the component id. Gunsight_UpdateAndPaint and MfdStatusScreen_Paint both read it.

entries.name: CockpitView_StaticInit
entries.description: Static initialiser of the cockpit view module (Borland _INIT_ entry 004a7b10, priority 0x20): stores 0, 4 and 0 at 004d0430, 004d0438 and 004d0440, and the six dwords 0, 1000, 0, -1000, 0, 0 at 0049b06e..0049b082 -- the last two are Cockpit_ZeroOffset (0049b07e), the {0, 0} offset Widget_DrawToCockpit uses when its third argument is null.

entries.name: GauWeaponRect_ElementCtor
entries.description: (rect): returns its argument -- the per-element constructor Gau_Load hands Rtl_VectorNew for the ten 16-byte weapon-row rects at .GAU +0x14 (PUSH 0x434ab9 at 004317ea; element size 0x10, count 10). Gau_Load's other five rect vectors use RectI_Ctor.

entries.name: SystemGadget_FlushDeferredPaintNoOp
entries.description: SystemGadget vtable +0x0c (0049b774): push ebp / mov ebp,esp / pop ebp / ret.

entries.name: SystemGadget_OnClickThunk
entries.description: The this-adjusting thunk at primary vtable +0x30 of SystemGadget's vtable block, in the table for its PanelGadget subobject at +0x20: subtracts 0x20 from this and jumps to SystemGadget_OnClick.

entries.name: SystemGadget_FlushDeferredPaintNoOpThunk
entries.description: The this-adjusting thunk at primary vtable +0x28 of SystemGadget's vtable block, in the table for its PanelGadget subobject at +0x20: subtracts 0x20 from this and jumps to SystemGadget_FlushDeferredPaintNoOp.

entries.name: SystemGadget_PaintThunk
entries.description: The this-adjusting thunk at primary vtable +0x24 of SystemGadget's vtable block, in the table for its PanelGadget subobject at +0x20: subtracts 0x20 from this and jumps to SystemGadget_Paint.

entries.name: ScrollTrigger_OnClick
entries.description: (strip): CockpitView_HandleEdgeTrigger (00433a88)(the strip's owner +0x20, strip). ScrollTrigger's vtable +0x08, the class's click.

entries.name: SystemGadget_Dtor
entries.description: SystemGadget's destructor (class record 00434ced): (gadget, flags). Four RTL destructor-count decrements, PanelSelectGadget_Dtor(gadget, 0), then Mem_Delete on flags bit 0.
entries.source: DBSIM decompile at 00434e05; class record at 00434ced

entries.name: MessagePort_QueueInit
entries.description: (queue): Rtl_VectorNew of ten 0x31-byte records at +0 with QueuedMessage_ElementCtor (00437558), then the int16 count +0x21c set to 0 and the ten in-use bytes at +0x212 cleared. MessagePort_CtorBase (00435490) builds two, the queue at port+4 and the message log at port+0x222. See docs/retail/simulation/cockpit-message-port.md, The queue.

entries.name: MessagePort_Enqueue
entries.description: (queue, record, entry): with the count +0x21c at 10 first MessagePort_QueueDropLast (004351c0). Takes the first record whose in-use byte (+0x212 + i) is clear, sets it, and fills the 0x31-byte record queue + i * 0x31: record's five dwords +2..+0x15 at +2, entry's text pointer (entry +0) at +0x18, and from the attribute bytes at entry +5: byte 0 as the int16 id +0x00, byte 1 (filename digit) at +0x16, byte 2 (priority) at +0x17, bytes 3 and 4 (minTime, maxTime) times 0x3c coarse ticks at +0x1c and +0x20, bytes 5 and 6 (minWait, maxWait) times 0x3c plus Time_GetCoarseTicks at +0x24 and +0x28, and bytes 7-11 at +0x2c..+0x30: byte 7 is the clip number, and bytes 8-11 lie past the eight a SYSTEM.STR entry supplies. With every record in use it queues nothing. Puts i in the order list +0x1ea at k, the first queued record whose priority is strictly greater, or at the end, so low sorts first, moving entries down one from position count - 2 to k, so the last queued entry is overwritten and the entry at the new count - 1 keeps the index it held; then adds 1 to the count.

entries.name: MessagePort_QueueFront
entries.description: (queue): 0 when the count +0x21c is 0, otherwise the record queue + slot0(+0x1ea) * 0x31. MessagePort_Tick takes it as the current message (+0x49a).

entries.name: MessagePort_QueueAt
entries.description: (queue, index): the queued record at slot index -- queue + slot(+0x1ea + index*4) * 0x31 -- or 0 when index is at least the count (+0x21c). MessagePort_QueueFront is the index-0 case. A 56-byte block inside it (004350e1-00435118) is jumped over: an inlined sprintf to 004d12c3 of a record's +0x18 string. Caller found by es2_xref: MessagePort_StampedQueueTimeAt.

entries.name: MessagePort_RemoveAt
entries.description: (queue, index): when the count +0x21c is nonzero, clears the in-use byte at +0x212 + the record index held in slot index of the order list +0x1ea, moves the later slots down one and takes 1 from the count.

entries.name: MessagePort_QueueDropLast
entries.description: (queue): clears the in-use byte at +0x212 + order[order[9]], the record named by the order entry (+0x1ea) whose position is the tenth order entry's (+0x20e) value, not of the tenth entry's own record, and takes 1 from the count +0x21c. MessagePort_Enqueue (00434e8c) runs it on a full queue (count 10).

entries.name: MessagePort_QueueNoOp
entries.description: Empty body (push ebp / mov ebp,esp / pop ebp / ret), between MessagePort_QueueDropLast and MessagePort_QueueExpire. No caller found by es2_xref.

entries.name: MessagePort_QueueExpire
entries.description: (queue): from the last order slot down to slot 1, MessagePort_RemoveAt (00435140) each whose record's maxWait deadline (+0x28) is below Time_GetCoarseTicks. Slot 0 is never dropped here.

entries.name: MessagePort_QueueRemoveMatch
entries.description: (queue, subject, id): removes the first queued record whose int16 id (+0) and subject pointer (+2) both match with MessagePort_RemoveAt (00435140) and returns 1; returns 0 when none does.

entries.name: MessagePort_QueueShiftDeadlines
entries.description: (queue, delta): adds delta to each queued record's +0x24 and +0x28 deadlines that are still later than Time_GetCoarseTicks. MessagePort_Resume calls it with the pause length.

entries.name: MessagePort_StampedQueueAppend
entries.description: (queue, record, msg): a five-slot variant of the message queue with a 9-byte string per slot at +0x21e. When the count (+0x21c) is 5 it drops slot 0 (MessagePort_StampedQueueRemoveAt). Takes the first free slot by its flag byte (+0x212 + id): copies record's five dwords at +2..+0x15 to the slot's record (queue + id*0x31), stores msg's attribute byte 0 (msg+5 points at the attributes) as the int16 at +0, attribute byte 1 at +0x16 and msg's text pointer (msg+0) at +0x18 -- msg is a SystemMessages_Index slot {text, count, attributes} -- copies PanelAmbience_FormatClock (00452218)'s HH:MM clock string (the PanelAmbience clock at PanelAmbience_ClockDigits (004d1e38)) into the slot's 9-byte string, and appends the id to the order list +0x1ea. No caller found by es2_xref.

entries.name: MessagePort_StampedQueueRemoveAt
entries.description: (queue, index): the same body as MessagePort_RemoveAt -- clears the flag byte of the id in slot index, shifts the later slots of +0x1ea down one and decrements the count +0x21c when it is non-zero. Caller found by es2_xref: MessagePort_StampedQueueAppend, with index 0.

entries.name: MessagePort_StampedQueueTimeAt
entries.description: (queue, index): the 9-byte clock string MessagePort_StampedQueueAppend stored for slot index (queue + 0x21e + id*9), or the empty string at 0049b928 when MessagePort_QueueAt returns 0 for that index. No caller found by es2_xref.

entries.name: MessagePort_CtorBase
entries.description: MsgPort constructor (vtable 0049bb00, RTTI name 'MsgPort', 0x4d3 bytes): builds the two queues at +4 and +0x222 with MessagePort_QueueInit, constructs the box at +0x49f as a GLRectangleRegion (vtable 004a327c) of type 0 holding the given rect at +0x4a7..+0x4b3, and clears the current message +0x49a, the latches +0x49e, +0x4c9..+0x4cb, +0x4d2 and the fields +0x4b7, +0x4b8, +0x4cc, +0x4d0. MessagePort_Ctor and DialogPort_Ctor run it first.
entries.source: DBSIM decompile at 00435490; RTTI at 0049bb00 and 004a327c

entries.name: MessagePort_PostNoOp
entries.description: MsgPort vtable +0x00 (0049bb00, the base of the cockpit message ports): an empty post. EventPort installs MessagePort_PickVariant, DialogPort PilotMessagePort_Post, CommandPort TrainingMessagePort_Post.

entries.name: MessagePort_ShiftRect
entries.description: (port, delta{dx, dy}): subtracts dx from port+0x4a7 and +0x4af and dy from +0x4ab and +0x4b3, moving the rect {x0, y0, x1, y1} at +0x4a7. CockpitView_ApplyViewState calls it on CockpitView_GetSquadMessagePort's port.

entries.name: MessagePort_AddBeginCallback
entries.description: (port, callback): while the count byte +0x4b7 is below 2 stores callback at port+0x4b9 + 4 * count, adds 1 and returns 1; returns 0 when both are taken. MessagePort_Tick runs each begin callback with the current message as it comes due.

entries.name: MessagePort_AddEndCallback
entries.description: (port, callback): stores callback in the next of two slots at port+0x4c1 (count byte +0x4b8) and returns 1; returns 0 when both are taken. The end twin of MessagePort_AddBeginCallback (004355a8); PilotMessagePort_Erase runs each with the current message.

entries.name: MessagePort_Tick
entries.description: The message port's whole lifecycle, on four latches: +0x4c9 due, +0x4ca ready (set by the port's own per-frame update, vtable +0x10, which is what puts one frame between due and shown), +0x4cb cancelled, +0x49e a line is up. Does nothing while +0x4cc is nonzero. Drops queued messages past index 0 whose maxWait has passed, takes the queue front as current, then: not ready and not cancelled -- drops it unshown past maxWait, else past minWait marks it due and runs the +0x4b9 begin callbacks; not due, or cancelled -- takes it down through the vtable's Erase when cancelled, when maxTime has passed, when minTime has passed and the queue holds more than one message, or when LocalPlayerMech+0x99 says the player's machine is dead, dequeuing only if Erase returns nonzero; due and ready -- calls the show (vtable +0x04) and, if it returns nonzero, adds the tick into minTime and maxTime and clears due. The minTime clause is the whole of the port's preemption.

entries.name: MessagePort_LineOverlapsRect
entries.description: (port, rect{x0, y0, x1, y1}): 1 when a line is up (+0x49e set), the display is not suppressed (+0x4d2 clear) and rect overlaps the port's box at +0x4a7..+0x4b3 (edges inclusive); 0 otherwise. No caller found by es2_xref.

entries.name: SystemMessages_Index
entries.description: (port, mode, n, bank): loads one .STR file into its string table and indexes it: mode 0 system into SystemStringTable, index 004d0b33; mode 1 commandX with the digit n into CommandStringTable, index 004d0971; mode 2 the pilot file with the digit bank into PilotStringTables + n * 0x10, index 004d04e8 + n * 0x183. The path comes from Language_StringFilePath. For each string StringTable_ReadNext returns, the 9-byte slot {char *text; byte count; byte *attributes} at index + attribute byte 0 * 9 takes the text and attributes while its count is 0, and its count goes up by 1: two entries sharing an id become variants of one message. All 63 retail SYSTEM.STR ids are distinct, so every count there is one.

entries.name: MessagePort_StepToVariant
entries.description: (port, table, record, n): for n > 0, calls StrTable_NextString (004539cc)(table, the record's string) n times, each with the record's own string, so any n gives the string after it, and returns a record built in the static at 004d0d6a -- the string at +0, 0 at +4, StrTable_GetAttributes (00453a08)(table, string) at +5; for n = 0 returns record unchanged. MessagePort_PickVariant and PilotMessagePort_Post pass it the rolled variant.

entries.name: MessagePort_Withdraw
entries.description: (port, subject, id): withdraws a posted message, matching on the message id AND the record's +0x02 subject pointer, so the same message about two machines is two entries. When the current message (+0x49a) matches: returns 0 while it is due (+0x4c9: past its delay, waiting to go up), else sets the cancel latch +0x4cb and returns 1; the show clears +0x4c9, so a line already on screen is cancelled. Otherwise returns MessagePort_QueueRemoveMatch (00435240)(port+4, subject, id).

entries.name: MessagePort_MarkReady
entries.description: (port, record): sets the ready latch +0x4ca when record is the current message and it is due. Called by the comm box as a squadmate's portrait starts talking (HddDisplay_ServiceCommBoxes), and by CommBox_OnMessageBegin when the box cannot open.

entries.name: MessagePort_Cancel
entries.description: (port, record): sets the cancel latch +0x4cb when record is null or the current message. The comm box calls it when a squadmate's portrait script runs out.

entries.name: MessagePort_Pause
entries.description: Marks the port paused, recording the coarse tick it stopped at. Paired with MessagePort_Resume.

entries.name: MessagePort_Resume
entries.description: Shifts every deadline in the queue, the current message's two display deadlines and the scroll's publish time forward by however long the pause lasted, so a paused line keeps the rest of its display time.

entries.name: DialogPort_Ctor
entries.description: (port, rect): DialogPort's constructor (vtable 0049bad4, RTTI name 'DialogPort', 0x4df bytes -- the pilot and squad message port): runs MessagePort_CtorBase (00435490), installs its vtable, and allocates two buffers of Region_PixelCount(+0x4a3) bytes with Mem_NewArray at +0x4d3 (the screen under the box) and +0x4d7 (the box as painted).

entries.name: PilotMessagePort_Post
entries.description: (port, record): vtable slot 0 of the ordinary pilot/squad port (0049bad4). A record whose +0x02 subject is null takes its id's slot from the command index 004d0971 against CommandStringTable (004d04c8); otherwise Squad_IndexOf picks the squadmate slot, and the slot index 004d04e8 + slot * 0x183 + id * 9 against PilotStringTables (004d0498) + slot * 0x10. The test meant to drop a subject in no slot compares EDX, holding the zero-extended low byte of Squad_IndexOf's result (255 for -1), with -1, which never holds, so such a post goes on with slot 255 and reads past the index. Rolls among variants as MessagePort_PickVariant does, then MessagePort_Enqueue (00434e8c)(port+4, record, slot). See docs/retail/simulation/cockpit-message-port.md, Rejected readings.

entries.name: PilotMessagePort_ComposeLine
entries.description: (port, record): DialogPort vtable +0x08. Builds the pilot/squad channel's display line into the buffer at DAT_004d0d73 and returns it: the speaker's name, ": ", then the message text (+0x18) strncat'd at 0x4a characters. The name comes from the speaker's comm box through Squad_PilotName of Squad_IndexOf(subject), or from PilotMessagePort_GetHqName when the record names no object. With no record it empties the buffer.

entries.name: PilotMessagePort_Speak
entries.description: The ordinary pilot/squad port's show (DialogPort vtable +0x04). Returns 0 without doing anything while the player's machine is dead (LocalPlayerMech+0x99) or the cockpit view manager's view-change flag +0x1c is set. Runs the BC_ voice arm below, then returns 1 without painting when PILOT MESSAGE is 1 (VOICE ONLY); otherwise composes the line (vtable +0x08), sets +0x49e, paints, clears +0x4d2 and returns 1. Paints the pilot/squad channel's box: one line, sized to its own measured width plus a 10-unit margin each side and centred on the screen, filled with the speaking squadmate's COLORS.DAT colour and framed in the palette entry one below it, in ColorSchemePanels[2] CPRED. A message with no squadmate behind it takes ids 19 and 9 instead. Named for the BC_00000 voice arm it opens with, gated on record +0x2c (attribute byte 7): 0 for every PILOT<n>.STR line and 1 for every COMMAND0.STR one, so it is HQ's voice, and no BC_ clip ships. See docs/retail/simulation/cockpit-messages.md, Its speakerless set.

entries.name: PilotMessagePort_Erase
entries.description: DialogPort and CommandPort vtable +0x0c, EventPort's MessagePort_Erase slot. Returns 1 at once when no line is up (+0x49e) or the display is suppressed (+0x4d2). Otherwise, unless the cockpit view manager's +0x1c byte is set (then it returns 0): calls each of the +0x4b8 end callbacks at +0x4c1 with the current message (+0x49a), restores the box's background from the save-under at +0x4d3 (Region_Restore inside Cockpit_PushCanvasContext/Cockpit_PopRenderContext), MessagePort_CopyBoxBetweenPages(port, 1), clears +0x49e and +0x4d2 and returns 1.

entries.name: PilotMessagePort_Update
entries.description: Ordinary pilot/squad port (vtable 0049bad4) slot +0x10. Sets the ready latch +0x4ca for a due message only when the record's +0x2c (attribute byte 7) is set; while a line is up (+0x49e) and not suppressed (+0x4d2), gives the display (006c5f54) its +0x8c page as source page +0x38 and repaints through slot +0x18; then MessagePort_Tick.

entries.name: TrainingMessagePort_Ctor
entries.description: Builds the training mission's pilot/squad port on top of the ordinary one (00435bf0): installs vtable 0049baa8, stores ColorSchemePanels[10] WHITE (0049b0d4) as its font at +0x4df, and extends the rect by eleven text lines to size the two save-under buffers.

entries.name: TrainingMessagePort_Post
entries.description: Training port (vtable 0049baa8) slot 0. Ignores the record's subject: enqueues the id's first COMMAND<n>.STR entry from the table at 004d0971, with no variant roll.

entries.name: PilotMessagePort_WrapText
entries.description: Training port (vtable 0049baa8) slot +8. Joins an instruction -- the id's first COMMAND<n>.STR entry and the count-1 entries after it in file order (StrTable_NextString) -- into 0x78-byte lines at DAT_004d0e13, at most 80 characters in the 640-wide mode and 60 in the 320-wide one. A sentence that fits is appended after a space; one that does not is split at its last fitting space, the head appended after a space (even to an empty line) and the rest copied unwrapped onto the next line. Sets +0x4eb to the line count, +0x4e7 to (lines + 1) * (8 << YCoordShift) and +0x4e3 to the measured width of the line with the most characters.

entries.name: TrainingMessagePort_Update
entries.description: Training port (vtable 0049baa8) slot +0x10. Repaints a line that is up, sets the ready latch for any due message, then MessagePort_Tick.

entries.name: PilotMessagePort_Paint
entries.description: The training mission's pilot/squad port class (vtable 0049baa8) show: the lines PilotMessagePort_WrapText built, left-aligned in ColorSchemePanels[10] WHITE on the computer's black with a red frame, the box as wide as the widest line plus 10 units each side, centred on the screen, (lines + 1) text lines tall from the .GAU rect's top (raised on this path by the offset-1664 lift). Then, unless PILOT MESSAGE is TEXT ONLY, plays <drive.cfg dir>\simvoice\TM<n>_<id+1>.wav through Voice_PlayNamed.

entries.name: MessagePort_Ctor
entries.description: (port, rect): EventPort's constructor, the computer's ticker: MessagePort_CtorBase (00435490)(port, rect), EventPort's vtable 0049ba7c, the blink latch +0x4d3 cleared, the box rect +0x4a7..+0x4b3 copied to +0x4d4..+0x4e0, 0 at +0x4e4 and -1 at the int16 +0x4e8.

entries.name: MessagePort_SetText
entries.description: Latches the line the ticker will draw: strncpy of 0x50 characters, so a longer message is truncated there.

entries.name: MessagePort_PickVariant
entries.description: (port, record): EventPort vtable +0x00, the ticker's post. Takes the system index slot 004d0b33 + id * 9 (id the record's byte +0); with its count byte +4 at 2 or more rolls the variant as Math_RandomNext(0x4d268f)'s low word modulo the count, and a nonzero variant goes through MessagePort_StepToVariant (00435a74) against SystemStringTable (004d04d8); a slot with text (+0) and attributes (+5) goes to MessagePort_Enqueue (00434e8c)(port+4, record, slot). The same roll SOUNDS.STR attribute byte 6 drives; no retail SYSTEM.STR id has more than one variant.

entries.name: MessagePort_Show
entries.description: Puts the current message up (EventPort vtable +0x04). Returns 0 at once while the player's machine is dead (LocalPlayerMech+0x99). When COMPUTER MESSAGE is 1 (VOICE ONLY), or the cockpit view manager's current view +0x14 reads 4 (the external view), it sets +0x49e and the suppression flag +0x4d2 and goes straight to the voice: no text, no tone, and the repeat window is neither tested nor refreshed. Otherwise it swallows a repeat of the same id inside 300 coarse ticks (about 4.8 s), returning 0 with the cancel latch set, and a swallowed repeat refreshes that window rather than leaving it. Otherwise latches the line, restores the box rect, publishes the scroll origin, repaints, plays an alert tone picked by a switch on the id (0x00/0x13 -> 0x19 strcfail; 0x0c/0x0f/0x10/0x14/0x15 -> 0x18 wrnwoop2; everything else 0x1a gnract -- the switch names fourteen further ids (0x17, 0x19, 0x1d-0x1f, 0x2a-0x2f, 0x34, 0x37, 0x38) that all reach the default arm's tone, and 0x36, whose arm also sets the blink latch +0x4d3). Both paths then speak the line unless COMPUTER MESSAGE is 0 (TEXT ONLY), and return 1. Message 0x36 TRANSFERRING DATA is armed to blink here.

entries.name: MessageTicker_Paint
entries.description: EventPort vtable +0x18. Returns at once while the cockpit view manager's view-change flag +0x1c is set; otherwise paints only while a line is up (+0x49e) and not suppressed (+0x4d2), and CockpitView_RectCornerVisible accepts the box. Paints the computer's ticker: the box flooded with COLORS.DAT id 19 (black), a one-pixel frame in id 9 (red) through the fill brush's style 4, and the line in ColorSchemePanels[2] CPRED. Narrows the live clip rect by 3 << VideoMode_XCoordShift on each side before the glyphs go down, so the text slides under the frame rather than past it. Anchors the glyph row at ((height - cellHeight) >> 1) + inkHeight + 1, which HudFont_DrawGlyph subtracts inkHeight back off -- the cell centred in the box, not Label_SetRect's ink-centred rule. Message 0x36 is centred instead of scrolled.

entries.name: MessageTicker_ScrollText
entries.description: (port): EventPort vtable +0x10. Recomputes the scrolling line's x (004d1314) every frame as port+0x4af - (0x23 << VideoMode_XCoordShift) * (Time_GetCoarseTicks - the publish time 004d1318) / 0x3c: it starts at the box's right edge and travels left at 35 authored units a second, 70 device pixels in the 640-wide mode, with no wrap. Then paints through slot +0x18, sets the ready latch +0x4ca when the due latch +0x4c9 is set, and runs MessagePort_Tick.

entries.name: MessagePort_Erase
entries.description: (port): EventPort vtable +0x0c. While a line is up (+0x49e) and not suppressed (+0x4d2), fills the box rect +0x4a7 with the brush {0, color 004d3c26} through Raster_FillRect between Cockpit_PushCanvasContext and Cockpit_PopRenderContext, MessagePort_CopyBoxBetweenPages(port, 1), and clears +0x49e, +0x4d2 and the blink latch +0x4d3. Returns 1 either way.

entries.name: PilotMessagePort_RestoreBackground
entries.description: DialogPort and CommandPort vtable +0x14: while a line is up, the display is not suppressed and the view manager's +0x1c byte is clear, puts the box's background back from the save-under at +0x4d3 (Region_Restore(port+0x4a3, port+0x4a7, +0x4d3) between Cockpit_PushCanvasContext and Cockpit_PopRenderContext). EventPort and MsgPort leave the slot empty (MessagePort_UnpaintNoOp).

entries.name: PilotMessagePort_RedrawFromSaveUnder
entries.description: DialogPort and CommandPort vtable +0x18, the slot EventPort fills with MessageTicker_Paint. Under the same three gates as PilotMessagePort_RestoreBackground: offsets the box rect (+0x4a7..+0x4b3) by the canvas origin (context +0x220/+0x224), saves the screen under it into +0x4d3 (Region_Save), takes the offset back off, and puts the box's own pixels back from +0x4d7 (Region_Restore).

entries.name: MessagePort_CopyBoxBetweenPages
entries.description: (port, direction): while a line is up (+0x49e) and +0x4d2 is clear, copies the box region at +0x4a3 between the display's pages with Region_CopyBetweenPages at offset {0, 0}: page +0x88 to +0x8c for direction 0, +0x8c to +0x88 for 1. Hides the cursor around the copy and shows it again unless the view manager's +0x14 is 4 and 0049dd8c is 0; restores the draw page after.

entries.name: MessagePort_StaticInit
entries.description: Static initialiser of the cockpit message module (Borland _INIT_ entry 004a7b16, priority 0x20): Rtl_VectorNew of three StringTables at PilotStringTables (004d0498, 16 bytes each, StringTable_Ctor), then StringTable_Ctor on CommandStringTable (004d04c8) and SystemStringTable (004d04d8). MessagePort_StaticDtor undoes it.

entries.name: MessagePort_StaticDtor
entries.description: MessagePort_StaticInit's _EXIT_ routine (Borland _EXIT_ entry 004a7c2a): OwnedArray_Dtor(SystemStringTable, 2), OwnedArray_Dtor(CommandStringTable, 2), then Rtl_VectorDelete of the three PilotStringTables with OwnedArray_Dtor.

entries.name: TrainingMessagePort_Dtor
entries.description: CommandPort's destructor (class record 004373a3; table 0049baa8): (port, flags). Six RTL destructor-count decrements, then Mem_Delete on flags bit 0. Frees neither save-under buffer DialogPort_Ctor allocated.
entries.source: DBSIM disassembly at 004373f7; class record at 004373a3

entries.name: DialogPort_Dtor
entries.description: DialogPort's destructor (class record 0043734f; table 0049bad4): (port, flags). Five RTL destructor-count decrements, then Mem_Delete on flags bit 0. Frees neither save-under buffer (+0x4d3, +0x4d7) DialogPort_Ctor allocated.
entries.source: DBSIM decompile at 00437439; class record at 0043734f

entries.name: MessagePort_Dtor
entries.description: EventPort's destructor (class record 004372fb; table 0049ba7c, the computer's ticker MessagePort_Ctor builds): (port, flags). Five RTL destructor-count decrements, then Mem_Delete on flags bit 0.
entries.source: DBSIM disassembly at 004374ce; class record at 004372fb

entries.name: MessagePort_DtorBase
entries.description: MsgPort's destructor (class record 00437482; table 0049bb00): (port, flags). Four RTL destructor-count decrements, then Mem_Delete on flags bit 0.
entries.source: DBSIM decompile at 00437517; class record at 00437482

entries.name: QueuedMessage_ElementCtor
entries.description: (record): returns its argument; the LEA of +6 is an inlined empty member constructor. The per-element constructor MessagePort_QueueInit hands Rtl_VectorNew for a queue's ten 0x31-byte records (PUSH 0x437558 at 00434e57; element size 0x31, count 10).

entries.name: MessagePort_UnpaintNoOp
entries.description: (): push ebp / mov ebp,esp / pop ebp / ret: an empty body. Slot +0x14 of MsgPort (0049bb00) and EventPort (0049ba7c), whose tables es2_naming vtables reads from the image; DialogPort and CommandPort hold PilotMessagePort_RestoreBackground there.

entries.name: MessagePort_GetRect
entries.description: (port): returns port + 0x4a7, the rect MessagePort_ShiftRect (00435574) moves. Slot +0x1c of all four message-port tables, MsgPort, EventPort, DialogPort and CommandPort, as es2_naming vtables reads them from the image.

entries.name: MessagePort_PaintNoOp
entries.description: MsgPort vtable +0x18: an empty body.

entries.name: SimStrings_LoadAll
entries.description: (path): StringTable_Load(SimStringTable, path), then 41 StringTable_LoadGroup(SimStringTable, destination, capacity, attributes) registrations in file order, so a group's index is its position in this sequence. The first alone passes an attribute array (DAT_004d1374, beside its destination DAT_004d132c); the sixth fills MfdCaptionTable with 13. es2_xref finds one call, from ColorSchemePanels_LoadAll at 004310d2. See docs/retail/formats/str-strings.md.

entries.name: SimStrings_StaticInit
entries.description: Static initialiser of the STRINGS0.STR module (Borland _INIT_ entry 004a7b1c, priority 0x20): StringTable_Ctor on SimStringTable (004d131c).

entries.name: SimStrings_StaticDtor
entries.description: SimStrings_StaticInit's _EXIT_ routine (Borland _EXIT_ entry 004a7c30): OwnedArray_Dtor(SimStringTable, 2).

entries.name: PaperDoll_InitTables
entries.description: Allocates the per-type 0x5c-byte .PDG table PaperDoll_Load fills, loads the weapon-icon bank weapons.hba/.dba into DAT_004d1754, and reads pdg\WEAPONS.PDG's {width, height} pairs into WeaponIconSizes, shifted by VideoMode_X/YCoordShift.

entries.name: PaperDoll_Load
entries.description: (name, slot), pdamage.cpp's .PDG loader into the slot's 0x5c-byte record in the table at 0049bbe8. Loads the bank <name> from the folder at 0049bc4c with VideoMode_UseHiResBanks set and 0049bc50 without, through Resource_Load, and opens pdg\<name>, asserting at severity 5 (pdamage.cpp, line 0x48) when it does not open. Reads an int32 view count, then per view the bank's frame (its +8 array, by view index), two 8-byte {x, y} reads into +4 and +0xc shifted by VideoMode_X/YCoordShift (the second +1 each with the hi-res banks), an int32 region count and that many 0x1c-byte regions {int index, int left, top, right, bottom, int colorId, int recolorMode} built with PaperDollRegion_ElementCtor, each colorId resolved through HudColorTable in place and each rect shifted the same way; seven dwords per view. Then an int32 count and that many 0x14-byte hardpoints {int x, y, frameOffset, alignment, blitFlags} at +0x54 (count) and +0x58, x and y shifted. See docs/retail/formats/pdg-paper-doll.md.

entries.name: PaperDoll_GetView
entries.description: (machine, view): returns the machine's .PDG record (machine+0x1f2 type record, +0xda) + view * 0x1c -- one of the three 0x1c-byte views at the head of the 0x5c-byte record PaperDoll_Load fills. No caller found by es2_xref.

entries.name: PaperDoll_BuildWeaponIcons
entries.description: (machine): builds the machine's weapon-icon list and returns the Mem_New'd 8-byte {count, array} holder: count = the .PDG hardpoint count (type record +0x1f2, record +0xda, +0x54), 0x22-byte entries {bitmap, x, y, rect, blit flags, int16 gun index +0x20} from Rtl_VectorNew with PaperDollWeaponIcon_ElementCtor. Entry n is hardpoint n; it finds the Mech_GetGunLayout record whose slot byte +0x17 is n and takes the mount at that position of the array at +4 of the loadout at +0x202; that mount's template +0x50 plus the hardpoint's frame offset is the WEAPONS frame (none for an empty mount or -1), anchored by the hardpoint's alignment bits against WeaponIconSizes; blit flags 2 move it left by the bitmap's int16 width +6 (shifted for a doubled bank) less that size. es2_xref finds one call, from Sim_InitMissionSession at 00461bc5, which stores the result at mech+0x1fe.

entries.name: PaperDoll_RecolorRect
entries.description: (rect, keyIndex, tintIndex, mode), cdecl: repaints one .PDG region in place. Makes the display DAT_006c5f54's draw page +0x3c its source page +0x38 (through maybe_g_RasterRoutines_SetSourcePage when that display is current), offsets rect by the canvas context DAT_006c5ff4's +0x210, +0x214 less its +0x220, +0x224, returns when the top row is then negative, and walks the rect a row at a time, reading through g_RasterRoutines_GetPixel and writing through g_RasterRoutines_PutPixel. Modes 0 and 1 set a pixel equal to keyIndex to tintIndex (mode 0 as the range keyIndex..keyIndex shifted by tintIndex - keyIndex), both skipping the walk when the two agree; mode 2 adds tintIndex to every pixel but HudColorTable id 19's index (DAT_004d3c26); mode 3 sets a pixel equal to keyIndex to tintIndex. With VideoMode_PanelMode 3 and VideoMode_UseHiResBanks clear, every mode tests one pixel per block of 2^VideoMode_XCoordShift by 2^VideoMode_YCoordShift and writes the whole block. es2_xref finds six calls: one from MfdStatusScreen_Paint, five from HddDamageScreen_Update. See docs/retail/simulation/cockpit-hud-widgets.md#tinting.
entries.signature: void __cdecl PaperDoll_RecolorRect(int *rect, int keyIndex, int tintIndex, int mode)

entries.name: PaperDoll_RecolorRectFromArt
entries.description: (rect, art, artOrigin, keyIndex, tintIndex, mode), cdecl: PaperDoll_RecolorRect's set-up, top-row test and walk, with mode 0 testing art's own pixel (rows of its int16 width +6, pixels from +0xe) at the pixel's offset from artOrigin, offset like rect and divided by the block size, for keyIndex, writing tintIndex as a block for a doubled bank, whatever the two colors are. Modes 1 to 3 read the raster back as PaperDoll_RecolorRect's do and step one pixel, doubled bank or not. es2_xref finds one call, from HddDamageScreen_Update. See docs/retail/simulation/cockpit-hud-widgets.md#tinting.
entries.signature: void __cdecl PaperDoll_RecolorRectFromArt(int *rect, void *art, int *artOrigin, int keyIndex, int tintIndex, int mode)

entries.name: Damage_PickRegionTint
entries.description: (damage, region, stateAndColorOut), cdecl: picks the color one .PDG damage region is repainted in, writing {condition state, palette index} to the two-int block at stateAndColorOut. Bands are Damage_ToConditionState's -- intact >=90/74/51/1 -- and for the region mode at region+0x18 of 0, 2 or 3 the colors are HudColorTable ids 12, 15, 20, 9, 18 (green, yellow, orange, red, grey). Mode 1 instead keeps the region's own color id (region+0x14) for the top three bands, so an undamaged region is left alone, and takes ids 6 and 17 for the last two. Mode >= 4 writes uninitialized values there. See docs/retail/simulation/cockpit-hud-widgets.md.

entries.name: Damage_ToConditionState
entries.description: Maps a Q8 damage fraction to a STRINGS0.STR group 28 condition index: intact = (0x100-damage)*100>>8 (arithmetic shift), then >=0x5a OK (0), >=0x4a SHIELDS DN (1), >=0x33 INT DAMAGE (2), >=1 CRITICAL (3), else DESTROYED (4). Callers found by es2_xref: Cockpit_PowerUpTick, Player_DependentCondition and MfdStatusScreen_SetCondition; mfd.md has the MFD using it for subjects with no per-component readings, flyers and structures.

entries.name: PaperDoll_StaticInit
entries.description: Static initialiser of the paper-doll module (Borland _INIT_ entry 004a7b22, priority 0x20): Rtl_VectorNew(WeaponIconSizes 004d1758, 8, 0x1c, 1, Rtl_ReturnArg) -- 28 8-byte pairs.

entries.name: PaperDollType_ElementCtor
entries.description: (record): Rtl_VectorNew(record, 0x1c, 3, 1, PaperDollView_ElementCtor) and returns record -- the per-element constructor PaperDoll_InitTables hands Rtl_VectorNew for the per-type 0x5c-byte .PDG records (PUSH 0x438765 at 004378ea; element size 0x5c, count = its argument; the vector is stored at 0049bbe8).

entries.name: PaperDollRegion_ElementCtor
entries.description: (region): returns its argument; the LEA of +4 is an inlined empty constructor of the region's rect. The per-element constructor PaperDoll_Load hands Rtl_VectorNew for a view's 0x1c-byte regions (PUSH 0x438785 at 00437b15; element size 0x1c).

entries.name: PaperDollHardpoint_ElementCtor
entries.description: (entry): returns its argument. The per-element constructor PaperDoll_Load hands Rtl_VectorNew for the 0x14-byte weapon-icon hardpoint entries it stores at record+0x58 (PUSH 0x438790 at 00437bdd; element size 0x14).

entries.name: PaperDollWeaponIcon_ElementCtor
entries.description: (icon): returns its argument; the LEA of +0xc is an inlined empty constructor of the icon's rect. The per-element constructor PaperDoll_BuildWeaponIcons hands Rtl_VectorNew for its 0x22-byte weapon-icon entries (PUSH 0x438798 at 00437cb5; element size 0x22, count = the .PDG hardpoint count at +0x54).

entries.name: PaperDollView_ElementCtor
entries.description: (view): returns its argument. The per-element constructor PaperDollType_ElementCtor hands Rtl_VectorNew for a .PDG record's three 0x1c-byte views (PUSH 0x4387a3 at 0043876c).

entries.name: Label_Ctor
entries.description: A 0x21-byte HUD text label: zeroes it, stores the font at +0x00 and the panel-relative flag at +0x18 that makes Label_SetText subtract the global blit offset. Paired with Label_SetRect and Label_SetText.

entries.name: Label_SetRectAroundPoint
entries.description: (label, point{x, y}, text, flags): sizes the label's rect (+4..+0x10) to text's HudFont_MeasureString width w around point: flags 2 centres (x0 = x - w/2, x1 = x0 + w, anchor x +0x14 = their midpoint), 4 right-aligns (x1 = x, x0 = x - w + 1, anchor x = x), otherwise left (x0 = x, x1 = x + w, anchor x = x); y0 = y - HudFont_CellHeight2/2 and y1 = y. Stores anchor y +0x16 = font+0x16 + y1 + y, so y is counted twice, and flags at +0x19; returns label+4. No caller found by es2_xref.

entries.name: Label_SetRect
entries.description: Anchors a HUD text label: stores the caller's rect at label+1..4 and computes the text anchor. Horizontal depends on the flags argument -- 2 = centre ((x1-x0)/2 + x0 + margin[0]), 4 = right (x1 - margin[0]), otherwise left (x0 + margin[0]). Vertical has no flag at all: anchorY = ((y1-y0)>>1) + y0 + (inkHeight>>1) + margin[2] + 1, where inkHeight is font+0x16 (file offset 0x1a, 11 for .HFN) and NOT the cell height at font+0xa. All of it is integer arithmetic. margin is the caller's short[4]. Paired with Label_SetText. See docs/retail/simulation/mfd.md.

entries.name: Label_SetText
entries.description: Sets a HUD label's text and places it against the anchor Label_SetRect computed. Measures the run and subtracts 1<<XCoordShift (dropping the trailing advance), then places left/centre/right per the same flags. Vertical position is the stored anchor; HudFont_DrawGlyph then draws each glyph with its top row at anchor - inkHeight, so the inked band is what gets centred in the rect and the remaining cell rows hang below. Fills the label's background first when its +0x1d colour id is non-zero, with the brush {0, colour} at the current render context's +0x22c and Raster_FillRect. For a panel-relative label (+0x18) it subtracts 004d25da/004d25de from the fill rect and the pen. See docs/retail/simulation/mfd.md.

entries.name: Label_SetNumber
entries.description: (label, n): _itoa(n, buffer, 10) into a stack buffer and Label_SetText(label, buffer). No caller found by es2_xref.

entries.name: Label_CtorWithAltFont
entries.description: (label, font, panelRelative): Label_Ctor, then stores the same font again at +0x21, the hotkey font that Label_SetTextWithHotkey draws its one character in, making a 0x25-byte label. es2_xref finds calls from MfdFlashCommScreen_Ctor and HddCommandScreen_Ctor.

entries.name: Label_SetText_Thunk
entries.description: Forwards (label, text) to Label_SetText.

entries.name: Label_SetTextWithHotkey
entries.description: (label, text, index): sets the label's text through Label_SetText_Thunk, then, when index is at most the string's length, puts a NUL at text[index], advances the pen x at 004d1838 by HudFont_MeasureString of the text before it, restores the character and draws it again with HudFont_DrawGlyph in the hotkey font at label+0x21. es2_xref finds its calls in MfdFlashCommScreen_Paint, MfdFlashCommScreen_Update (two), HddCommandScreen_Update (two) and HddCommandScreen_RefreshOrders.

entries.name: Label_StaticInitNoOp
entries.description: Borland _INIT_ entry 004a7b28 (priority 0x20): a lone RET. Placed after Label_SetTextWithHotkey, at the end of the Label block, where this binary puts each module's static initialiser.

entries.name: PanelGauge_Ctor
entries.description: (this, rect, arg): PanelGauge base constructor. Installs PanelGaugeVtable (0049bc6c), copies rect's four ints to +4..+0x10 and arg to +0x14, clears the sensor-dropout state (+0x74 condition, +0x76/+0x77 dark flag, +0x78 deadline, +0x6c sequencer, +0x8c/+0x8d, +0x90, +0xb0) and defaults both spell ranges to 180-360 coarse ticks (+0x7c..+0x88), sequences +0x70 = 0 and +0x72 = 1.

entries.name: PanelGauge_TickDropout
entries.description: The sensor dropout's two-state toggle over PanelGauge +0x6c..+0x88: +0x76 = 1 dark, 0 shown, its previous value copied to +0x77 first. Draws each state's length with PanelGauge_RollDuration from +0x7c/+0x80 (dark) or +0x84/+0x88 (shown) onto Time_GetCoarseTicks and flips when it passes; with a sequencer at +0x6c the expiry selects and starts sequence +0x70 or +0x72 at the rect +4, steps it each later call, and flips when the step reports the end. Condition +0x74 == 0 forces dark.

entries.name: PanelGauge_RollDuration
entries.description: (Math_RandomNext(presentation generator 0x4d268f) & 0xffff) % (hi - lo) + lo; returns lo without drawing when hi == lo.

entries.name: Widget_PressChild
entries.description: (gauge, index, flags): unless the child at gauge+0x18[index] is in state 2, calls its press slot (+0x17 vtable, +8) with flags as if it had been clicked, then queues it on the cockpit root's press flash (WidgetRoot_FlashPress) so it shows pressed for 10 coarse ticks. This is how a bound key reaches a button: CockpitWidgets_HandleCommand, ConsoleButtons_HandleCommand, MfdDisplay_KeyDispatch and HddDisplay_KeyDispatch press their buttons through it rather than duplicating each button's own action, and es2_naming.py callers finds more.

entries.name: Widget_BeginPowerUpAnimation
entries.description: Starts one cockpit widget's power-up animation: sets the armed byte at widget+0x8c and stamps widget+0x90 with Time_GetCoarseTicks. Both live on the shared widget base, cleared by its constructor (00438b20) along with the done byte at +0x8d, and each class reads them in its own paint -- for the roving gunsight that is the compass wind-up in Gunsight_UpdateAndPaint. Cdecl with one stack argument and no used return: all eight call sites, in Cockpit_PowerUpTick and the flyer tail of Gau_BuildCockpitWidgets, discard EAX and pop their own argument.

entries.name: VideoMode_ShiftRect
entries.description: (rect{x0, y0, x1, y1}): shifts the x fields left by VideoMode_XCoordShift and the y fields by VideoMode_YCoordShift, scaling authored 320-wide coordinates to the current mode. HddGau_ApplyCoordShift and MfdGau_ApplyCoordShift use it.

entries.name: Widget_ClickSound
entries.description: push 0x11; call Sound_Play. Slot +8 of the secondary (CTLControl subobject) vtable in every button-family gadget class. It is called with the subobject pointer and ignores it, which is why one function serves them all; the slider family replaces it with the empty stub 00439014 and is therefore silent.

entries.name: Widget_ForwardClickToOwner
entries.description: The base OnClick at leaf-widget vtable slot +8, installed by the intermediate class at vtable 0049dee4 and inherited unchanged by the shield facings, the MFD's momentary button class and the HDD buttons. Gated on the left-button bit; calls owner->vtable[0](owner, self, buttonFlags) through the owner pointer the constructor stored at +0x24, then repaints itself and sounds Widget_ClickSound through slot +8 of its second vtable at +0x20.

entries.name: PanelSelectGadget_Dtor
entries.description: PanelSelectGadget's destructor (class record 004594a0), which every button leaf's destructor ends in: (gadget, flags). Reinstalls PanelSelectGadgetVtable at +0x17 and its PanelGadget mixin table at +0x20, Mem_Deletes +0x2c, deletes each of the three objects at +0x30/+0x34/+0x38 through its own vtable +0x18 with flags 3, then Mem_Delete on flags bit 0.
entries.source: DBSIM decompile at 00438e70; class record at 004594a0

entries.name: PanelStateGadget_OnClick
entries.description: PanelStateGadgetVtable +0x08 (gadget, flags): when flags bit 0 is set, flips the state byte +0x40, calls the owner's (+0x24) vtable slot 0 with (owner, gadget, flags), then slot 1 of the vtable at +0x17 and slot 2 of the sub-object at +0x20.

entries.name: PanelSliderGadget_Dtor
entries.description: PanelSliderGadget's destructor (class record 00455599), which every slider leaf's destructor runs on its mixin subobject at +0x3e: (mixin, flags). Reinstalls PanelSliderGadgetVtable at +0, Mem_Deletes +8, deletes the object at +0x10 through its own vtable +0x18 with flags 3, Mem_DeleteArrays +0x14 when set, GLBitmapArray_Dtor(+0x38, 3), then Mem_Delete on flags bit 0.
entries.source: DBSIM decompile at 00438f4c; class record at 00455599

entries.name: Widget_NoClickSound
entries.description: An empty function standing in for Widget_ClickSound at slot +8 of the slider family's secondary vtable. Dragging the throttle, or any other PanelHSliderGadget/PanelVSliderGadget leaf, makes no sound.

entries.name: HSliderGadget_OnClick
entries.description: OnClick (+0x08) of WeaponSliderGadgetVtable, ThrottleHSliderGadgetVtable and PanelHSliderGadgetVtable: the same body as VSliderGadget_OnClick (0043904c) -- owner's slot 0 with (owner, slider, value), then slot 1 at +0x17 and slot 2 of the +0x3e sub-object.

entries.name: VSliderGadget_OnClick
entries.description: PanelVSliderGadgetVtable +0x08 (slider, value): calls the owner's (+0x42) vtable slot 0 with (owner, slider, value), then slot 1 of the vtable at slider+0x17 with the slider, then slot 2 of the sub-object at slider+0x3e. HSliderGadget_OnClick (0043901c) has the same body.

entries.name: BarGraph_Ctor
entries.description: BarGraph constructor (vtable 0049bd78, RTTI name 'BarGraph', 0x2c bytes): copies the rect {x0, y0, x1, y1} to +4..+0x10. LedBarGraph_CtorBase and LedBarGraph_CtorV run it first.

entries.name: BarGraph_NoOp
entries.description: Empty body (push ebp / mov ebp,esp / pop ebp / ret) between BarGraph_Ctor and BarGraph_GetRect. No caller found by es2_xref.

entries.name: BarGraph_GetRect
entries.description: Returns obj+4, the rect {x0, y0, x1, y1} BarGraph_Ctor copies there. es2_xref finds ten calls: one each from EnergyPoolGauge_Paint and EnergyPoolGauge_Update and four each from ThrottleSlider_PaintV and ThrottleSlider_FlushPaintH.

entries.name: LedBarGraph_CtorBase
entries.description: LedBarGraph_CtorBase(obj, rect, range): BarGraph_Ctor over the rect and vtable BarGraphHVtable, then field 0x14 = span = (rect x1 - rect x0) * 0x10000 / range, 0x18 = rect x0, 0x1c = rect x1, and the fill position 0x20 = 0x1c when span is below 1, else 0x18.

entries.name: BarGraphH_PaintToValue
entries.description: BarGraphH vtable +0x00 (0049bd60), (bar, value): pos = start (+0x18) + value * span (+0x14) >> 16, or end (+0x1c) minus that for a non-positive span; fills the lit run in colour +0x28 and the rest of the track in +0x24 with Raster_FillRect through the rect at +4, and stores pos at +0x20.

entries.name: BarGraphH_RepaintSpan
entries.description: BarGraphH vtable +0x04, (bar, a, b): orders a and b, clamps them to the track (+0x18..+0x1c) as lo and hi, and refills x lo..hi against the stored fill position +0x20, the lit part with the brush the render context holds and the unlit part in +0x24. Filling from the start (span +0x14 of 1 or more): unlit when pos < lo, the brush when hi < pos, else lo..pos unlit and pos..hi with the brush. Filling from the end: unlit when hi < pos, the brush when pos < lo, else lo..pos with the brush and pos..hi unlit. So a run pos splits is lit on the side BarGraphH_PaintToValue leaves unlit.

entries.name: LedBarGraph_CtorV
entries.description: BarGraphV constructor (bar, rect, range): BarGraph_Ctor, BarGraphV's vtable 0049bd48 at +0, the span +0x14 = (y1 - y0) * 0x10000 / range, start +0x18 = y0, end +0x1c = y1, and the fill position +0x20 = start when the span is below 1, else end. The vertical twin of LedBarGraph_CtorBase (004390c4). es2_xref finds BarGraphV's paint and repaint, 00439398 and 00439460, in BarGraphV's vtable alone; the throttle's two bars are in docs/retail/simulation/cockpit-hud-widgets.md#throttle-gauge.

entries.name: BarGraphV_PaintToValue
entries.description: BarGraphV vtable +0x00 (0049bd48), (bar, value): with the span +0x14 below 0, pos = start (+0x18) + (value * span >> 16), filling start..pos in the lit color +0x28 and pos+1..end (+0x1c) in the unlit color +0x24; otherwise pos = end - (value * span >> 16), filling pos..end lit and start..pos-1 unlit; stores pos at +0x20. It writes those positions to the rect's x0 (+4) and x1 (+0xc), not y0 and y1, so it fills a band across x over the rect's whole height. BarGraphH_PaintToValue tests the span below 1. es2_xref finds it in BarGraphV's vtable alone.

entries.name: BarGraphV_RepaintSpan
entries.description: BarGraphV vtable +0x04, (bar, a, b): BarGraphH_RepaintSpan on the rect's y0 (+8) and y1 (+0x10) with the side tests mirrored, so a run the fill position +0x20 splits is lit on the side BarGraphV_PaintToValue lights. Filling from the start (span +0x14 below 1): unlit (+0x24) when pos < lo, the render context's brush when hi < pos, else lo..pos with the brush and pos..hi unlit; filling from the end: unlit when hi < pos, the brush when pos < lo, else lo..pos unlit and pos..hi with the brush.

entries.name: LedBarGraph_Ctor
entries.description: LEDBarGraphH constructor (bar, rect, range): LedBarGraph_CtorBase, then LEDBarGraphH's vtable 0049bd30 at +0.

entries.name: LedBarGraph_PaintToValue
entries.description: (bar, value): paints the bar to a value over its range, working on the bar's rect at +4 {x0, y0, x1, y1}, whose x it rewrites for each fill. With a span (field 0x14) of 1 or more it fills from start (0x18) to fillEnd = start + (value * span >> 16), both included, through LedBarGraph_FillPinstripe, then the remainder fillEnd + 1 .. end (0x1c) with Raster_FillRect in field 0x24's colour. With a span below 1 it fills from end - (value * span >> 16) to end, then the remainder from start to one before the fill. The current brush's colour is swapped for the remainder and put back, and the fill's moving end is stored at 0x20.

entries.name: LedBarGraph_RepaintToValue
entries.description: LEDBarGraphH vtable +0x04 (0049bd30), (bar, value): draws the whole bar for value without storing it. pos = start (+0x18) + (value * span >> 16) for a span +0x14 of 1 or more, else end (+0x1c) - (value * span >> 16); start..pos through LedBarGraph_FillPinstripe (00439758), then pos + 1..end through a temporary {0, +0x24} brush installed at the render context's +0x22c, put back after. For a span below 1 that lights the side LedBarGraph_PaintToValue leaves unlit. The stored position +0x20 is untouched.

entries.name: LedBarGraph_FillPinstripe
entries.description: (bar, rect {x0, y0, x1, y1}): fills an LED bar's lit span as full-height Raster_DrawLine lines from y0 to y1, walking x0..x1 inclusive twice: even columns in field 0x2c's colour, then odd columns in 0x30's. The colour goes in as a temporary {0, colour} pen in the current render context, the previous one restored after. Two near-identical shades interleaved at one pixel read as a single shaded fill.

entries.name: LEDBarGraphV_Ctor
entries.description: LEDBarGraphV constructor (vtable 0049bd18, RTTI name 'LEDBarGraphV', 0x3c bytes): (obj, rect, range) runs LedBarGraph_CtorV, which builds the BarGraphV (0049bd48) part, then installs its own vtable; it sets no color. es2_xref finds one call, at 00444edc in EnergyPoolGauge_Ctor.

entries.name: LedBarGraphV_PaintToValue
entries.description: LEDBarGraphV vtable +0x00 (0049bd18), (bar, value): BarGraphV_PaintToValue's runs, the lit one drawn by LedBarGraphV_FillPinstripe (00439a0c) and the remainder by Raster_FillRect after the installed brush's colour is set to +0x24 (put back after). With the span +0x14 below 0, pos = start (+0x18) + (value * span >> 16), start..pos lit and pos + 1..end (+0x1c) unlit; otherwise pos = end - (value * span >> 16), pos..end lit and start..pos - 1 unlit. Like BarGraphV_PaintToValue it writes the positions into the rect's x0 and x1 (+4, +0xc). Stores pos at +0x20.

entries.name: LedBarGraphV_Repaint
entries.description: LEDBarGraphV vtable +0x04: redraws the whole bar at the stored fill position +0x20 -- one side through a temporary {0, +0x24} brush at the render context's +0x22c, the other with the vertical pinstripe fill at 00439a0c, which side by the span's sign. Its argument is loaded and not used.

entries.name: LedBarGraphV_FillPinstripe
entries.description: (bar, rect{x0, y0, x1, y1}): LedBarGraph_FillPinstripe turned on its side. Installs a temporary {0, colour} brush at the render context's +0x228 and draws Raster_DrawLine from (x0, y) to (x1, y) on every second row of y0..y1: first the even rows in colour +0x2c, then the odd rows in +0x30; restores the brush. LedBarGraphV_PaintToValue (twice) and LedBarGraphV_Repaint (twice) call it, per es2_xref.

entries.name: LedBmBarGraphH_Ctor
entries.description: LEDBMBarGraphH constructor (table 0049bd00, RTTI 'LEDBMBarGraphH', 0x68 bytes), (bar, rect, range, bitmapA, bitmapB): LedBarGraph_CtorBase, its own table, two GLRectangleRegion members at +0x2c and +0x44 (each with the dword after its vptr zeroed), the two bitmaps at +0x60 and +0x64, and a 5000-byte Mem_NewArray block at +0x5c.

entries.name: LedBmBarGraphH_PaintToValue
entries.description: LEDBMBarGraphH vtable +0x00 (0049bd00): BarGraphH_PaintToValue's layout. For a positive span the lit run and the remainder are drawn by 00439c48 with the bitmaps at +0x64 and +0x60; for a non-positive span both are Raster_FillRect. Stores the position at +0x20.

entries.name: LedBmBarGraphH_RepaintNoOp
entries.description: LEDBMBarGraphH vtable +0x04: push ebp / mov ebp,esp / pop ebp / ret.

entries.name: LedBmBarGraphH_DrawBitmapSpan
entries.description: (bar, bitmap): draws the columns of bitmap that line up with the bar's current rect (+4..+0x10). Sets region +0x2c's rect (+0x34..+0x40) to the bitmap's size (+6 columns, +4 rows, shifted by VideoMode_X/YCoordShift) at the canvas origin (render context 006c5ff4 +0x220/+0x224), and region +0x44's rect (+0x4c..+0x58) to the bar's rect moved left by the track start (+0x18) onto that origin. Points the raster's source page (+0x38) at its draw page (+0x3c), saves the screen under region +0x2c into the 5000-byte block +0x5c (Region_Save), draws bitmap there with Bitmap_Blit and again with VideoMode_BlitBitmap, copies region +0x44 back to the bar's own position with Region_CopyBetweenPages, and restores region +0x2c from the save (Region_Restore). LedBmBarGraphH_PaintToValue calls it with the lit (+0x64) and unlit (+0x60) bitmaps, per es2_xref.

entries.name: LedBmBarGraphV_Ctor
entries.description: LEDBMBarGraphV constructor (table 0049bce8, RTTI 'LEDBMBarGraphV', 0x68 bytes): LedBmBarGraphH_Ctor's body over LedBarGraph_CtorV.

entries.name: LedBmBarGraphV_PaintToValue
entries.description: LEDBMBarGraphV vtable +0x00 (0049bce8), (bar, value): LedBarGraphV_PaintToValue's runs, both drawn by LedBmBarGraphV_DrawBitmapSpan (00439f70), the lit one from the bitmap at +0x64 and the unlit one from +0x60; the positions go into the rect's x0 and x1 (+4, +0xc). Saves the installed brush's colour and puts it back unchanged. Stores pos at +0x20.

entries.name: LedBmBarGraphV_RepaintNoOp
entries.description: LEDBMBarGraphV vtable +0x04: push ebp / mov ebp,esp / pop ebp / ret.

entries.name: LedBmBarGraphV_DrawBitmapSpan
entries.description: (bar, bitmap): LedBmBarGraphH_DrawBitmapSpan on the y axis -- the bar's rect is moved up by the track start (+0x18) onto the bitmap -- and with a single blit (VideoMode_BlitBitmap) where the H routine blits twice. LedBmBarGraphV_PaintToValue calls it four times, per es2_xref.

entries.name: BarGraphV_ResetToEmpty
entries.description: Vtable +0x08 of BarGraphV, LEDBarGraphV and LEDBMBarGraphV: stores the empty position in +0x20 -- the track end (+0x1c) for a positive span, the start (+0x18) otherwise.

entries.name: BarGraphH_ResetToEmpty
entries.description: Vtable +0x08 of BarGraphH, LEDBarGraphH and LEDBMBarGraphH: stores the empty position in +0x20 -- the track start (+0x18) for a positive span, the end (+0x1c) otherwise.

entries.name: LedBmBarGraphH_Dtor
entries.description: LEDBMBarGraphH's destructor (class record 0043a1a9): (bar, flags). Seven decrements of the runtime's destructor count (through Rtl_DtorCountPtr), then Mem_Delete when bit 0 of flags is set. It frees neither the 5000-byte block at +0x5c nor anything else the constructor allocated. es2_xref finds its address as a dword at 0043a1d1, in the class record, and no rel32 branch to it.
entries.source: DBSIM disassembly at 0043a22a; class record at 0043a1a9

entries.name: LedBmBarGraphV_Dtor
entries.description: LEDBMBarGraphV's destructor (class record 0043a128): LedBmBarGraphH_Dtor's body.

entries.name: MfdStatusScreen_Ctor
entries.description: Constructor for the MFD's status screen, shared by mode 0 (STATUS, F1) and mode 4 (TARGET, F5) -- MfdDisplay_Ctor builds one of each. Lazily loads the `bases`, `vehicles` and `flyers` sprite banks (folder "hba"/"dba" off VideoMode_UseHiResBanks) for target silhouettes, sets the wireframe viewport to inset+(0x2d,0xd)-(0x5f,0x3a), and builds five text labels from tables at 0049bd84 (x0), 0049bd8e (y0) and 0049bd98 (font selector into {ColorSchemePanels[10] WHITE, [14] RED}). The obvious reading of the sprite-bank load is that this is the BASES.DAT type-table loader, and it has been named Bases_LoadTypeTable on that basis; it is not. What this loads is the BASES *sprite* bank for target silhouettes. The BASES *data* file is read by Base_LoadResources (00405fac), which has no relationship to this function. See docs/retail/simulation/mfd.md.

entries.name: MfdStatusScreen_Paint
entries.description: The MFD status screen's paint (MFDStatus vtable +0), (screen), shared by F1 and F5. Installs the brush {0, 0x11} at the render context's (006c5ff4) +0x22c and fills the viewport rect +0x24 with its y0 moved down and its x1 and y1 moved in by 1 << VideoMode_XCoordShift. Latches the subject at +0x3e from the shared block's (+8) +8: taken when that is set or nothing is latched; a latched subject whose entry is gone is dropped unless its +0x99 or +0xa4 is set, then held until a paint past the deadline +0x3a, 300 coarse ticks after the paint that set the flag +0x39. No subject: label 1 (+0x14) in ColorSchemePanels[0], labels 0-1 DAT_004d1574 and DAT_004d1690, labels 2-4 empty. Class +0x1a8 0, a HERC: unless the scramble flag +0x34 is set, VideoMode_BlitBitmap of the paper doll's view 2 (type +0x1f2, +0xda, +0x38) at its origin plus the viewport's top-left plus (0x11, 2); Mech_ReadDamageReadouts; label 0 ID: (DAT_004d1570) for the cockpit's machine or a squadmate (Squad_IndexOf), TARGET: otherwise; label 1 YOU, the squadmate's HddGauge_Name or the type name (_strupr of type +0x58), XXXXXXXXX while scrambled, in ColorSchemePanels[1] when the side byte (+0x12 of the group at +0x45) is 0 and [2] otherwise; label 2 STATUS:; per region the walker means of the readings, or for a flyer chassis (type +0x50) the single readings 1 and 5-9, through Damage_PickRegionTint and PaperDoll_RecolorRect; the state (4 for +0x99, 3 when readings 20-31 all exceed 0x80, 2 when any exceeds 0, 1 for +0xb0, else 0) to MfdStatusScreen_SetCondition with the damage vtable +0x40 returns. Then, unscrambled, for side byte 1 with CockpitView+0x27c set, it outlines (brush mode 4, colour DAT_004d3c20) the rect, grown one pixel on each side, of the first region whose id is CockpitView+0x27e or the region that id merges into (1 to 0, 9 and 11 to 7, 10 and 12 to 8, 15-18 to 13). Class 2, a flyer: flyers frame 0; classes 1 and 3: the bases or vehicles bank (type +0x32) frame type +0x28; each centred in the viewport by its frame size, doubled for VideoMode_PanelMode 3 without hi-res banks; label 0 TARGET:, label 1 the flyer's type name (_strupr of +0x12 of +0x1fa) or the group 23 or 24 name, label 2 STATUS:, SetCondition with state -1. Other classes: TARGET: and DAT_004d1694 in ColorSchemePanels[0]. Every subject but none then, for side byte 1, sets label 4 to DAT_004d1578 followed by _itoa of Math_DistanceBetweenPoints from the cockpit's machine (CockpitViewInstance +0x203), or XXXXX while scrambled. See docs/retail/simulation/mfd.md.

entries.name: MfdStatusScreen_Update
entries.description: The status screen's vtable +4, (screen): when +0xc holds 100, sets it to 0, sets the scramble flag +0x34 and the deadline +0x35 to Time_GetCoarseTicks + 0x1e; otherwise, with +0x34 set, clears it once the ticks pass the deadline. Then runs the paint slot +0 and Widget_DrawToCockpit (0043122c)(1, the rect at +4, 0).

entries.name: MfdStatusScreen_SetCondition
entries.description: (screen, damage, friendly, state): writes the MFD status screen's labels 3 and 4. Unscrambled (+0x34 clear): label 3 (+0x1c) takes MfdStatusConditionStrings[state] (STRINGS0.STR group 28), the state being Damage_ToConditionState(damage) when -1 is passed; with friendly non-zero, label 4 (+0x20) reads "[ " (0049be2c), _itoa((0x100 - damage) * 100 >> 8) and "% ]" (0049be2f), so undamaged reads "[ 100% ]". Scrambled: label 3 reads "XXXXXX" (0049bdba) and, with friendly non-zero, label 4 "XXX" (0049bdc1). See docs/retail/simulation/mfd.md.

entries.name: MfdStatusScreen_StaticInitNoOp
entries.description: Borland _INIT_ entry 004a7b2e (priority 0x20): a lone RET. Placed after MfdStatusScreen_SetCondition, at the end of the block that runs from PanelGauge_Ctor to the MFD status screen.

entries.name: Gunsight_ClickGadget_OnClickNoOp
entries.description: Slot +0x08 of HUDRovingGunsightGadgetVtable (0049c188), the gunsight click gadget's OnClick, (gadget, flags): tests bit 0 of flags and returns. ES1's slot (ES1DBSIM 000337dc) arms the pixel pick under that bit.

entries.name: GunsightChild_CtorBase
entries.description: HUDGauge constructor, the base of the roving gunsight's children, (child, rect): stores HUDGaugeVtable (0049c26c) at +0 and the rect {x0, y0, x1, y1} at +4..+0x10.

entries.name: HudSlideBar_CtorBase
entries.description: RotationGauge constructor, the base of the HUD's sliding bars, (bar, rect): GunsightChild_CtorBase, RotationGaugeVtable (0049c24c) at +0, limits -0x4800 and 0x4800 at +0x24 and +0x26, the range 0x4800 - min at +0x2c and the value (min + max) >> 1, unsigned 16-bit, at +0x3a.

entries.name: HudSlideBar_SetLimits
entries.description: Slot +0x10 of the rotation gauges' vtables, (bar, min, max): min to +0x24, max to +0x26, the range max - min to +0x2c and the value (min + max) >> 1, unsigned 16-bit, to +0x3a, then the bar's slot +8, the recompute.

entries.name: HudSlideBar_AddDelta
entries.description: Slot +0xc of the rotation gauges' vtables, (bar, delta): the value +0x3a less delta, stored when it lies within [+0x24, +0x26], otherwise the limit it passed.

entries.name: HudRotationIndicator_Ctor
entries.description: HFixRotationGauge constructor, the manual's rotation indicator, (bar, rect): HudSlideBar_CtorBase, HFixRotationGaugeVtable (0049c22c) at +0, then the bar's slot +8, HudRotationIndicator_Recompute. See docs/retail/simulation/cockpit-gunsight-hud.md.

entries.name: HudRotationIndicator_Recompute
entries.description: HFixRotationGauge vtable +8, (bar): the width x1 - x0 (+0xc - +4) to +0x28 and the track point (x0, y0 - (2 << VideoMode_YCoordShift)) to +0x2e and +0x32.

entries.name: HudRotationIndicator_Paint
entries.description: HFixRotationGauge vtable +0, (bar): between Cockpit_PushCanvasContext and Cockpit_PopRenderContext, blits Hud_BitmapBank frame 11 at the track point +0x2e, then frame 13 while the value +0x3a lies within -299..299 and frame 12 otherwise, at x = x0 + ((value - min) & 0xffff) * width (+0x28) / range (+0x2c, unsigned), plus 1 when the value is negative, less 15 << VideoMode_XCoordShift, and y = y0. See docs/retail/simulation/cockpit-gunsight-hud.md.

entries.name: HudSlideBar_CtorHidden
entries.description: VFixRotationGauge constructor, (bar, rect): HudSlideBar_CtorBase, then VFixRotationGaugeVtable (0049c20c) at +0, whose paint and recompute slots are the empty HudSlideBarHidden_PaintNoOp (0043b574) and HudSlideBarHidden_RecomputeNoOp (0043b56c).

entries.name: HudSlideBarHidden_RecomputeNoOp
entries.description: VFixRotationGauge vtable +0x08 (0049c20c), the recompute slot: an empty body.

entries.name: HudSlideBarHidden_PaintNoOp
entries.description: VFixRotationGauge vtable +0x00 (0049c20c), the paint slot: an empty body.

entries.name: HudHeadingTape_Ctor
entries.description: (tape, rect): gunsight child 1, the heading tick tape. HudRotationIndicator_Ctor (0043b438)(tape, rect), then HRevRotationGaugeVtable (0049c1ec) at +0; while HudHTickBank (0049be70) is 0 loads hudhtick into it with Resource_Load from the folder ResourcePath_BuildFolderName gives, hba while VideoMode_UseHiResBanks (004d25f0) is set and dba otherwise; then calls its slot +8, HudHeadingTape_Recompute (0043b5dc), and returns tape.

entries.name: HudHeadingTape_Recompute
entries.description: (tape): slot +8 of HRevRotationGaugeVtable (0049c1ec). With F the hudhtick bank's frame count (HudHTickBank (0049be70) +4) and its frame pointers at +8: +0x28 = the rect's width W (+0xc - +4), +0x3c = 0, +0x40 = F * W (computed as F * W * 0x10000 / 0x10000), +0x44 = the rect's x0, +0x48 = the last frame, +0x4c = the first, the int16 +0x50 = 1 and +0x52 = F - 2, or F - 1 when that is negative.

entries.name: HudHeadingTape_SetHeading
entries.description: (tape, heading): slot +0xc of HRevRotationGaugeVtable (0049c1ec). total = Math_Q16Multiply((ushort)heading, +0x40); frame = total / +0x28, offset = total % +0x28, and when offset reaches +0x28 it subtracts it and steps frame, wrapped to 0 at the bank's count (HudHTickBank (0049be70) +4). Writes +0x44 = the rect's x0 - offset, +0x48 = frame's pointer and +0x4c = the next frame's, wrapped.

entries.name: HudHeadingTape_Paint
entries.description: (tape): slot +0 of HRevRotationGaugeVtable (0049c1ec). Inside Cockpit_PushCanvasContext and Cockpit_PopRenderContext, saves the context's +0x210, +0x218, +0x220 and +0x224, sets +0x210 and +0x218 to the rect's x0 and x1 less the origin x +0x220 and +0x220 to x0 less the old +0x220, blits +0x48 at (+0x44, the rect's y0) and +0x4c at (+0x44 + +0x28, y0) with VideoMode_BlitBitmap, and restores the four.

entries.name: HudHeadingTape_Repaint
entries.description: HRevRotationGauge vtable +0x04 (0049c1ec): calls the gauge's own slot +0x00, HudHeadingTape_Paint.

entries.name: HudHeadingTape_SetLimits
entries.description: (tape, lo, hi): slot +0x10 of HRevRotationGaugeVtable (0049c1ec). +0x40 = (hi - lo) / +0x28, then HudSlideBar_SetLimits (0043b3c0)(tape, lo, hi), whose closing call of slot +8, HudHeadingTape_Recompute (0043b5dc), writes +0x40 again.

entries.name: Gunsight_ReticlePaint
entries.description: (child): slot +0 of HUDCrosshairGunsightVtable (0049c124), gunsight child 4's paint. Inside Cockpit_PushCanvasContext and Cockpit_PopRenderContext, blits with Bitmap_Blit one Hud_BitmapBank frame centred on the point +0x42/+0x46, the .GAU reticle point (offset 1136): frame 0 when the state block's object (+0x1a) is 0, when its point +0x1e..+0x29, taken to view space with the identity model transform (Raster_SetModelTransform, Raster_ModelToView), is less deep than ViewObjectPtr +0x1e, or when it projects (Raster_PerspectiveDivide, Raster_ProjectToScreen) further than 5 << VideoMode_XCoordShift across or 5 << VideoMode_YCoordShift down from +0x42/+0x46; otherwise frame 2 while the byte +0x39 is 0 and frame 1 while it is set. Puts the model transform back.

entries.name: Gunsight_TargetIndicator_Ctor
entries.description: (child, rect): gunsight child 5, the target box and its off-screen arrow. GunsightChild_CtorBase (0043b344)(child, rect), then HUDGunsightVtable and HUDLockingGunsightVtable (0049c1c4) at +0, whose slot 0 is Gunsight_TargetIndicatorPaint (0043b950).

entries.name: Gunsight_TargetIndicatorPaint
entries.description: Gunsight child 5's paint: the HUD target box (pip, four mirrored corner brackets, four edge ticks -- HUD frames 3-6 unlocked, 7-10 locked) and, when the target does not project inside the .GAU's offset-1148 rect, a flat-filled arrow at that rect's border pointing at it. Box side is clamp(2*(shapeRadius>>1)*focal/distance, 25, 75) device pixels, the clamp NOT coordinate-shifted. It is the only widget that calls Cockpit_PopRenderContext before drawing and Cockpit_PushCanvasContext after, so the box alone is clipped to the canopy cutout and goes behind the cockpit frame.

entries.name: Gunsight_ClickSurface_Ctor
entries.description: Gunsight child 0, the clickable gunsight surface, (child, rect): GunsightChild_CtorBase, then HUDGunsightVtable and HUDRovingGunsightVtable (0049c1b0) at +0. Allocates a 0x20-byte gadget with Mem_New and, when that succeeds, builds it with Widget_CtorRect(rect) and stores CTLButtonControlVtable with 0 at +0x1d and then HUDRovingGunsightGadgetVtable (0049c188) with 0 at +0x1b, at its +0x17. Keeps the gadget at +0x4a and registers it with Widget_RegisterClickable on the cockpit's clickable list (the dword at CockpitViewInstance).

entries.name: Gunsight_ClickSurface_Paint
entries.description: HUDRovingGunsight vtable +0 (0049c1b0), gunsight child 0's paint, (child): reads the cursor into +0x42/+0x46 with Cursor_GetPosition and calls Cockpit_SetForwardCursor(1) when that point lies in the rect +4..+0x10, bounds inclusive, and Cockpit_SetForwardCursor(0) otherwise.

entries.name: Gunsight_UnusedChild_Ctor
entries.description: (child, rect): gunsight child 6. Gunsight_TargetIndicator_Ctor (0043b928)(child, rect), then HUDPipperVtable (0049c174) at +0, whose paint slot, Gunsight_UnusedChild_Paint (0043c260), is an empty body.

entries.name: Gunsight_UnusedChild_Paint
entries.description: Slot +0 of HUDPipperVtable (0049c174), gunsight child 6's paint: an empty body (PUSH EBP, MOV EBP,ESP, POP EBP, RET).

entries.name: HudWaypointIndicator_Ctor
entries.description: Gunsight children 7 and 8, the manual's Waypoint Indicator. HudRotationIndicator_Ctor's object given vtable 0049c154 (paint Hud_UpdateWaypointIndicator, AddDelta HudWaypointIndicator_ShiftLimits) plus a label child at +0x4e on the rect it was handed dropped 3 << YCoordShift. Both children are handed the HEADING TAPE's rect and its +/-0xe38 limits; child 7 additionally sets its +0x45 flag, which is what makes it the nav marker's rather than the route's. The eight file-scope globals it writes are the diamond and arrow extents.

entries.name: HudWaypointIndicator_ShiftLimits
entries.description: (indicator, delta): slot +0xc of HNavGaugeVtable (0049c154), where the slide bars' tables hold HudSlideBar_AddDelta: adds delta to both int16 limits +0x24 and +0x26. Hud_UpdateWaypointIndicator (0043c3e4) reads the range +0x2c, which an equal shift of both leaves alone, and neither limit.

entries.name: Hud_UpdateWaypointIndicator
entries.description: Paint shared by gunsight children 7 and 8. The +0x45 flag picks the subject: set, NavMarker_Position and colour id 15 (DAT_004d3c1e); clear, the waypoint after the player group's route cursor with colour table entry 0, or -- on a branch gated by DAT_004d2af0, with no writer found by es2_xref.py -- the player's selected target. Takes the ground range with Vec2_DistanceBetween and the bearing as Math_Atan2Guarded(dx, dy) - 0x4000, then, inside a Cockpit_PushCanvasContext pair, draws the error (mech.heading - bearing) through Raster_DrawPolygonDispatch: within +/-0xe38 a filled diamond on the tape, corners bottom, left, top, right; beyond it a filled arrow past the rect's right or left end, tip first and then the base ends, the lower first on the right-hand arrow and the upper first on the left, so every outline winds clockwise. Child 8 also composes 'WAYPOINT ' + cursor+1 + ': ' + Hud_WorldUnitsToMetres(range) + ' M.' into its label.

entries.name: Gau_RovingGunsightWidget
entries.description: Large composite 'roving gunsight' HUD-overlay container (matches HUDRovingGunsightGadget/HUDLockingGunsight/HUDPipper class names). Contains the confirmed HTorsoTwist (child rect at 1104, loads bitmap 'hudhtick') and a target-speed text-readout anchor (offsets 1120/1124/1132, format string '000 K/H'). NAVBAR is confirmed NOT here.

entries.name: Gunsight_AddChild
entries.description: (gunsight, child): when child is non-null, stores it at +0xd7 + 4 * the count +0xff and adds 1 to the count, so construction order is child index.

entries.name: Gunsight_Paint
entries.description: (gunsight): the gunsight's paint. Unless the byte +0x76 (dark) is set or CockpitView_RectCornerVisible answers 0 for child 0's rect (+4 of the child at +0xd7), inside Cockpit_PushCanvasContext and Cockpit_PopRenderContext: calls slot 0 of each child over the +0xd7 array (count +0xff); while the byte +0xb3 of the instrument at CockpitViewInstance +0x1e1 is set, blits Hud_BitmapBank's frame 14 at the label +0x103's rect and sets that label's text to DAT_004d16d4; calls HudClock_Tick and Hud_UpdateSpeedReadout; sets the text of the labels DAT_004d1850, DAT_004d1854, DAT_004d1858 and DAT_004d185c; calls Gunsight_PaintHudScanner and Gunsight_PaintAltitudeScale.

entries.name: Gunsight_UpdateAndPaint
entries.description: (gunsight): the gunsight's vtable +8, once a frame. Returns at once when the manager CockpitViewManager_Published answers is in view 4 (+0x14) and its byte +0x1c is clear. Stores Player_DependentCondition(2) at the int16 +0x74 and, when it is non-zero, the int16 entries for it of the tables 0049be48, 0049be52, 0049be5c and 0049be66 at +0x7c, +0x80, +0x84 and +0x88, and runs PanelGauge_TickDropout. Unless the byte +0x76 is set or CockpitView_RectCornerVisible answers 0 for child 0's rect, inside Cockpit_PushCanvasContext and Cockpit_PopRenderContext: while Gunsight_PickArmed (0049be74) is set and ObjPick_IsIdle answers true, hands a non-zero ObjPick_GetObject to TargetSelect_SetObject with the cockpit +0x14, and stores 0 in Gunsight_PickArmed; copies CockpitView+0x26c to +0xb7 and, when it is non-zero, +0x270..+0x27b to +0xbb..+0xc6, the int16 +0x27c to +0xc9, the int16 +8 of the dword +4 of the object's +0x34 (read through 0 when +0x34 is 0) to +0xcd, 2000 to +0xd1 and the object's int16 +0x10 to +0xc7; calls child 1's slot +0xc with the negation of the heading +0x10 of the machine at CockpitViewInstance +0x203, in whose place, while the byte +0x8c is set and +0x8d clear, it takes the wind-up ramp r = (ushort)((Time_GetCoarseTicks() - +0x90) * 0x32) for a heading up to 0x8000 and -r above it, until r reaches the heading or -r falls to it, when it sets +0x8d and takes the heading; calls slot +4 of each child; then the ATT legend, HudClock_Tick, Hud_UpdateSpeedReadout, the four labels' text, Gunsight_PaintHudScanner and Gunsight_PaintAltitudeScale as Gunsight_Paint (0043d5c8) does.

entries.name: Gunsight_SetValues
entries.description: Called once a frame by Player_PerFrameCockpitUpdate with the machine's heading (mech+0x10), turret twist (+0x298) and turret pitch (+0x29a). Caches them at widget+0xb1/+0xb3/+0xb5 and forwards each one's delta to a child's AddDelta slot (+0xc): heading -> child 7 as (new - old), twist -> child 2 (the rotation indicator) as (old - new), pitch -> child 3 as (old - new).

entries.name: Gunsight_GetStateBlock
entries.description: (gunsight): returns gunsight + 0xb1, the roving gunsight's state block that Gunsight_SetValues (0043d98c) takes. es2_xref finds calls from Player_PerFrameCockpitUpdate, TargetSelect_SetObject, TargetSelect_Nearest and TargetSelect_Cycle; the last three set the block's byte +0x24 to 1.

entries.name: Gunsight_ShiftChildRects
entries.description: (gunsight, delta{dx, dy}): subtracts dx from x0/x1 and dy from y0/y1 of the rect (+4..+0x10) of five of the roving gunsight's children: +0xdb (HudHeadingTape), +0xdf (HudRotationIndicator), +0xe3 (the hidden HudSlideBar), +0xe7 (the GunsightChild_CtorBase reticle) and +0xf3 (the first HudWaypointIndicator) -- children 1-4 and 7 in Gau_RovingGunsightWidget's Gunsight_AddChild order. No caller found by es2_xref.

entries.name: Hud_UpdateSpeedReadout
entries.description: Formats the HUD speed text: itoa(Mech_GetDisplaySpeedKph(LocalPlayerMech)) followed by the literal ' K/H' (0049c112). The gadget it writes into is DAT_004d185c, built in Gau_RovingGunsightWidget against the width template '000 K/H'.

entries.name: HudClock_Tick
entries.description: The front window's TIME: clock: when Time_GetCoarseTicks passes the deadline at 004d1888, pushes it to now + 0x3c and carries the ASCII digits MM at 004d1860 and SS at 004d1863 by one second, wrapping 99:59 to 00:00, then rebuilds 'MM:SS' at 004d1868. Gunsight_Paint and Gunsight_UpdateAndPaint call it.

entries.name: Gunsight_PaintAltitudeScale
entries.description: (gunsight): only for a flyer (type record +0x50): from the point at +0x113 draws a scale 0x24 << YCoordShift tall out of Hud_BitmapBank frames 15-18 -- frame 15 at the point and 16 at the foot, a narrow column at frame 15's right edge filled in palette 0x4b up to the terrain height under the machine and edged in 0x49 above it, frame 17 at the machine's height (mech+0x2e), and frame 18 twice as a tape scrolled by height / 50. Heights map from grid+0x110 at the foot to grid+0x114 + 5000 at the top, clamped. For the tape it narrows the installed canvas context to the strip (rect +0x210..+0x21c, mode +0x208 = 1) and zeroes its origin +0x220/+0x224 but leaves the context's translation flag +0x20c at 1, so both tape blits are moved by the strip's own top-left and land right of the strip: the tape is never drawn. Gunsight_Paint and Gunsight_UpdateAndPaint call it inside Cockpit_PushCanvasContext.

entries.name: Gunsight_PaintHudScanner

Gau_RovingGunsightWrapper runs it on the .GAU block at +1088 (0x440), as Gau_ThrottleWidget does GauThrottle_ApplyCoordShift.
